The student builds a corpus of questions, runs them through these services under controlled conditions, and records the resulting network activity.

projects.title: SYS1: Empirical Threat Models in Censorship Circumvention
projects.summary: Examines why some censorship circumvention designs achieve large-scale success while others with strong theoretical potential have had no practical impact. The project takes a cryptographic threat-modelling perspective on empirical censorship behaviour and deployed circumvention tools.

projects.title: A collaborative document-annotation system based on reStructuredText
projects.summary: Extend reStructuredText with inline annotations and discussions that remain robust to changes in the document, keeping a single source of truth.

projects.title: A deduplicating file system based on content-aware chunking
projects.summary: Design a deduplicating file system that splits files into content-defined chunks so that insertions do not break deduplication, possibly on a live system. A follow-up explores normalizing binaries (e.g. jump targets) before deduplication.

projects.title: A different kind of performance profiler
projects.summary: Design a profiler that uses memory snapshots and taint tracking to flag redundant or unused computations, reporting how many distinct results each function computes and whether its results are used, to suggest memoization or removal.

projects.title: A proof-friendly representation of hardware circuits
projects.summary: Design or identify a circuit representation that is easy to reason about in Rocq, to retarget the Kôika compiler and reduce its trusted base, and explore module representations including linking theorems.

projects.title: Abusing the instruction cache to store data
projects.summary: Encode constant data in dynamically generated code so that it occupies the instruction cache rather than the data cache, for instance by unrolling a loop that adds a constant vector with the constants as immediates.

projects.title: Add post-macro-expansion mode to latexdiff
projects.summary: Patch latexdiff to expand simple custom LaTeX macros before running its diff algorithm, so that changes inside macro expansions are shown rather than only macro invocations.

projects.title: Alectryon ports to new proof languages
projects.summary: Extend Alectryon to support additional proof languages and protocols beyond Rocq and Lean, such as F* and HOL-light, building on existing EasyCrypt support.

projects.title: An Alectryon backend for coqdoc
projects.summary: Write a coqdoc backend that generates Alectryon documents, making it easier to switch between the two documentation tools for Rocq.

projects.title: Better unification
projects.summary: Make Rocq's unification errors more eager by pinpointing where a naive unification attempt fails, instead of rejecting the whole goal against a lemma.

projects.title: Code-size optimizations for keyboard macros
projects.summary: Design and implement an optimizer that suggests shorter key combinations for keyboard macros as users type, such as replacing a multi-key sequence with an equivalent single binding. Follow-ups cover ergonomic hand models and telemetry across users.

projects.title: Compressed datastructures and application-specific RAM compression
projects.summary: Investigate application-specific compression schemes for in-memory data that stay compatible with the operations performed on the decompressed data, for example compressing the two sides of an Emacs gap buffer separately.

projects.title: Cross-language editing and debugging
projects.summary: Write a translator from a legacy language such as COBOL into readable, idiomatic Python so that standard Python tools can be used, together with a reverse translator that back-propagates changes to the source.

projects.title: Deriving tools from annotated grammars
projects.summary: Enhance a parser generator such as Menhir to accept indentation and other annotations, so that one grammar drives syntax highlighting, indentation, structural editing and folding, with error recovery for partial programs.

projects.title: Does semantic versioning work?
projects.summary: Study whether human-assigned version numbers follow semantic versioning, using static API diffs and downstream test breakage to check version increments in software ecosystems.

projects.title: Early reclamation for lazy values in Scala
projects.summary: Change the JVM backend of the Scala compiler to null out stack variables right after their last use so that lazy lists are not pinned in memory, with a follow-up on avoiding leaks in iterators and coroutines.

projects.title: Fixing reStructuredText
projects.summary: Design and implement a conservative extension of reStructuredText that supports nesting of inline constructs and reduces the need for heavy indentation of long text blocks.

projects.title: Fused decompression and decoding
projects.summary: Explore fusing decompression with decoding so that redundant content in compressed streams (e.g. gzip+JSON) is decoded once and reused through backpointers instead of being re-decoded for every repetition.

projects.title: Hierarchical rendering of separation-logic formulae
projects.summary: Turn the SepViz system into a hierarchical renderer that alternates rendering and layout and nests diagrams and formulae, so that higher-order predicates, non-prenex quantification and complex predicates in iterated separating conjunctions can be displayed.

projects.title: Hindley-Milner for Rocq
projects.summary: Explore adding Hindley-Milner style generalization of type variables to Rocq's type inference for simple non-dependently typed definitions such as map, and study how this approach fails.

projects.title: Mixed rendering for proof presentation
projects.summary: Design a modular constraint-solving renderer that encodes common pretty-printing and graph layout problems and uses it to render proof goals mixing several domains, with a notation mechanism in Rocq and rendering close to previous goals for continuity.

projects.title: PCP encoding for Rocq's VM
projects.summary: Investigate a probabilistically checkable proof (PCP) encoding of traces of Rocq's virtual machine, so that a claimed proof reduction can be verified cheaply.

projects.title: Printing with sharing
projects.summary: Add a Rocq printing option similar to Lisp's *print-circle* that shows term sharing, to make it easier to debug term size and memory usage in performance issues.

projects.title: Profiling automated verifiers
projects.summary: Build a profiler that attributes SMT solving time across the verifier stack (e.g. symbolic executor and SMT solver) and identifies redundant solver work such as useless quantifier instantiations, evaluated on real verifier performance issues.

projects.title: Reducing common sources of branch target aliasing
projects.summary: Explore software and hardware approaches that reduce branch-prediction aliasing in lazy-value forcing code and bytecode interpreters, for example by giving each lazy value its own branch or exposing the interpreted program counter to the hardware.

projects.title: Single-step eauto
projects.summary: Implement an eauto_one tactic for Rocq that applies a single lemma from a given hint database matching the current goal, to replace a complicated typeclasses eauto and shelve trick for forward reasoning.

projects.title: Static-checking RPG quests
projects.summary: Use automated program verification to prove reachability, liveness and linearity properties of role-playing game quests written in modding languages, to detect bugs such as stuck quests or rewards obtained twice.

projects.title: The user experience of mechanized diagram-chasing proofs
projects.summary: Build lightweight mockups of scripted interactions to explore layout algorithms, incremental re-layout, and representation choices for diagrams in diagram-chasing proofs within a proof assistant.

projects.title: What performance do compiler updates buy you?
projects.summary: Compile historical programs with successive versions of a compiler such as GCC to measure runtime gains and compilation cost, with a follow-up on which optimizations speed up compiling the compiler itself.

projects.title: In-context learning as approximated Bayesian inference
projects.summary: Examines whether the in-context learning ability of transformers can be explained as implicit gradient descent, as the 'ICL as GD' hypothesis proposes. The project aims to show that for more complex statistical problems and architectures, transformers learn more sophisticated mechanisms, such as approximated Bayesian inference.

projects.title: Characterizing Neuronal Activity in Brain Organoids Across Neurodevelopmental Disorder Mutants
projects.summary: Analyzes existing multielectrode array (MEA) recordings from brain organoids carrying neurodevelopmental disorder-associated mutations and healthy controls, quantifying network activity features such as firing rates, bursts and synchrony. The student then trains interpretable machine learning classifiers to distinguish mutant from wildtype organoids, with an optional extension on developmental timepoints.

projects.title: Learning trajectories in models and children
projects.summary: Treats language model training as a developmental trajectory and asks whether the order and timing of language abilities emerging in artificial systems match those of children. The work combines training densely checkpointed models from scratch (with learned tokenizers, joint text-vision-audio learning, and constrained initializations) with structural probing, in collaboration with developmental neuroscientists and psycholinguists.

projects.title: Characterization of bone-tissue scaffolds
projects.summary: Explore the mineralization of hydrogels printed via tomographic volumetric additive manufacturing (TVAM) or digital light processing (DLP) printing, for bone-tissue scaffolds.

projects.title: Double network semicrystalline polymers
projects.summary: Develop double network polymers based on ring-opening metathesis polymerization (ROMP).
skills: wet lab experience (required for ALCHEMY master projects)

projects.title: Joint Master's Thesis with Empa – Spring 2027
projects.summary: A joint Master's thesis opening with Dr. Michael Stuer at Empa.

projects.title: Printing of hollow metal structures
projects.summary: Develop a method of fabricating hollow metal structures via digital light processing (DLP) printing.

projects.title: Sustainable metal sheet "printing"
projects.summary: Establish a proof-of-concept method for the polymer-derived fabrication of sheet metal.
skills: wet lab experience (required for ALCHEMY master projects)

projects.title: Adaptive Digital Control and Self-Optimizing Calibration Architecture for Superconducting Qubit Systems
projects.summary: Design a fully digital FPGA (or ASIC) control architecture for superconducting qubits that combines a DDS-based pulse generation engine with an autonomous calibration sequencer and an online learning algorithm. The goal is to continuously optimise qubit control fidelity while reducing hardware resource use, validated on a transmon qubit system with a Zurich Instruments SHFQC readout backend.

projects.title: Cryogenic Transistor Model for CMOS Electronics Used in Quantum Applications
projects.summary: Develop a SPICE-compatible compact model of transistors (extending the simplified EKV model) that captures their behaviour at room temperature and 4 K, implemented in Verilog-A and validated against measurements. The work covers extending the model to AC/RF, parameter extraction, Ngspice simulations, and documentation.

projects.title: Enhancing Superconducting Detectors by Improved Fabrication Procedures - Characterisation
projects.summary: Characterise new fabrication techniques for superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) by building cryogenic test infrastructure and testing a range of devices, then use the conclusions to propose improved detector fabrication strategies.

projects.title: Evaluation of Single-Photon Detector for Elementary Particle Tracking
projects.summary: Characterize and evaluate state-of-the-art CMOS single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) devices through experiments and simulations, to better understand the physical mechanisms behind SPAD behaviour for use in particle detectors as alternatives to SiPMs.

projects.title: GPU implementation of bi-exponential decay in FLIM for real time assistance in cancer cell localization
projects.summary: Develop a GPU implementation of a GRU-based neural network that extracts bi-exponential fluorescence lifetime values from SwissSPAD2 SPAD sensor data for real-time FRET FLIM imaging, to assist in localizing cancer cells.

projects.title: Low-cost Cryogenic Infrastructure
projects.summary: Develop low-cost, open-source electronics to read out and control commercial cryostats (Gifford-McMahon, pulse-tube and sorption coolers reaching below 1 K), along with mechanical interface components for attaching apparatus to the cryostat.

projects.title: Mapping and scheduling Quantum Circuits on Distributed Cores with Logical Qubits
projects.summary: Study the mapping and scheduling of quantum circuits on distributed quantum cores hosting logical qubits, with attention to inter-core CNOTs and T gates. The work uses STIM to simulate stabilizers and analyse error levels for different code distances, and to study decoder placement and timing constraints; it is a follow-up to earlier preliminary work.

projects.title: ML-based Parameter Extraction for Cryogenic Transistor Compact Models
projects.summary: Develop a machine-learning algorithm to automatically and efficiently extract parameters of the sEKV transistor compact model, usable across model versions. The work targets cryogenic 22 nm FDSOI devices and includes verification with room-temperature PDK simulations and experimental cryogenic data.

projects.title: RTL implementation for real time FLIM measurements
projects.summary: Implement the phasor-based FLIM lifetime computation (pile-up correction, background correction, phasor calculation, IRF deconvolution, lifetime calculation) in RTL on a Xilinx FPGA for real-time processing of SwissSPAD2 sensor data. The student would use Vivado High Level Synthesis to translate C/C++ into VHDL/Verilog.

projects.title: RTL-to-GDS flow for Superconducting Electronic Circuits
projects.summary: Develop a full RTL-to-GDS design toolset for digital circuits in single flux quantum (SFQ) superconducting technology, covering logic synthesis, routing and timing analysis. The work includes setting up the flow in the Synopsys toolset, with LVS and DRC checks, and later integrating the lab's own standard cell designs.

projects.title: System development of a real-time quantum distillation imager
projects.summary: Develop a real-time quantum distillation imaging system by synchronizing two SwissSPAD2 single-photon avalanche diode cameras. The work includes PCB design to merge the two cameras' PCIe interfaces, RTL design on a Xilinx FPGA for correlation processing, and streaming the merged signal to a GPU over PCIe 3.0.

projects.title: Test of a Photo Diode for the Swiss Light Source 2.0
projects.summary: Characterise a 50 GHz photodiode and its amplifier and bandpass filter chain, set it up with a picosecond laser, and measure its instrument response. The goal is to assess whether measuring the frequency content in different bands can determine the length of electron pulses in the Swiss Light Source 2.0 storage ring.

projects.title: Towards real time monitoring of blood oxygenation in human body through Time Domain Diffuse Correlations Spectroscopy
projects.summary: The student will update an existing FPGA design to compute the g2 algorithm in real time for time-domain diffuse correlation spectroscopy (TD-DCS) using the Piccolo Gated 32x32 SPAD sensor. The student will also build the optical setup and run experiments on a phantom mimicking human brain blood flow.

projects.title: Towards real time monitoring of brain oxygenation for premature born infants
projects.summary: The project aims to bring SPAD camera technology to real-time monitoring of brain oxygenation in premature babies, in collaboration with UZH. The student updates an FPGA design of the Piccolo Gated 32x32 TCSPC SPAD sensor to add DNL correction, after-pulse reduction and HDR enhancement, and applies reconstruction algorithms to image objects hidden beneath a phantom.

projects.title: Ultra-Low Dead-Time SPADs: Chip Testing and Characterization
projects.summary: Experimental validation and characterization of low-dead-time Bolt SPAD chips on fabricated silicon, including light-emission checks, breadboard testing with an oscilloscope, room and cold temperature tests, radiation robustness, and testing under different photon rates.

projects.title: Firmware development for ENVIROBOT
projects.summary: Continue the development of ENVIROBOT by adapting the existing firmware to a new generation of electronic boards and extending it with new functionality on the new platform.

projects.title: Mobile Manipulation of Assistive Robotic Furniture
projects.summary: Integrate robotic arms with a mobile robotic furniture platform and develop a whole-body controller so that a mobile manipulator can fetch objects for a wheelchair user, such as bringing a cup of water, in simulation (MuJoCo) and on the real robot.

projects.title: Modeling zebrafish sensorimotor integration using simulation and robots
projects.summary: Study and model zebrafish sensorimotor integration through neuromechanical simulation and the ZBot fishlike robot, in collaboration with Duke University. Possible directions include a new simulation framework, deep reinforcement learning for sensorimotor circuits, visually guided behaviors, and programming ZBot.

projects.title: Paleorobotics of Armored Tail Strikes: Simulation, Compliance, and Energy Dissipation in Extinct Mammalian Weapons
projects.summary: Use paleorobotics to test whether extinct armored mammals could generate powerful tail-club strikes, by building MuJoCo and SIMM/OpenSim-type models of a tendon-driven tail and mapping how strike energy is transferred and absorbed. Optional work includes a biomimetic carapace and a tendon-driven tail prototype. The project is split between EPFL and University of Zurich.

projects.title: Radio communication module on 169.4 MHz
projects.summary: Finalise a prototype bidirectional serial link based on a CC1120 radio chip at 169.4 MHz, by redesigning the PCBs, improving communication software and stability, adding a simple user interface on the microcontroller, and adding flow control on the robot side.

projects.title: Robotic paleontology: tail strike defense
projects.summary: Design and build a life-sized robotic tail based on a dinosaur or Glyptodont club tail to measure the impact force and velocity of tail strikes, using bone-like material reproductions from fossils. Experiments take place at Empa Dübendorf.

projects.title: Spine motion replication
projects.summary: Replicate the spine motion and degrees of freedom of quadruped animals with fewer actuators, reducing weight, bulk and mechanical complexity. The work is mainly software.

projects.title: User-Centric Multimodal Interaction for Assistive Robotic Environments
projects.summary: Study the everyday challenges of wheelchair users and investigate how multiple interfaces (markerless body-language tracking, LLM/VLM natural-language control, tablet interface) can provide accessible control of mobile robotic furniture. The student can further develop or evaluate one interaction modality.

projects.title: Label-free nanophotonic biosensing for spatiotemporal analysis of live-cell and tumoroid dynamics
projects.summary: Contributes to a platform based on plasmonic nanohole arrays and dielectric metasurfaces, integrated with microfluidics, to detect secreted biomolecules from single cells and tumoroids in real time. The goal is to study signalling dynamics for precision diagnostics, therapy monitoring and disease mechanisms.

projects.title: Metasurface-enhanced infrared spectroscopy for biochemical sensing applications
projects.summary: Develops infrared metasurfaces for surface-enhanced infrared absorption (SEIRA) spectroscopy to enable highly sensitive, multiplexed detection of bioanalytes in aqueous conditions and high-resolution mid-IR tissue imaging. The work also targets large-scale manufacturability for lab-on-chip and point-of-care devices.

projects.title: Self-illuminating plasmonic biosensors
projects.summary: Develops self-illuminating plasmonic biosensors based on metal-insulator-metal tunnel junctions that emit light through inelastic electron tunneling. The project covers design and nanofabrication of metasurface-based junctions, optical characterization of their emission, and biofunctionalization for selective analyte detection.

projects.title: A Board-Level Energy Harvesting Interface Circuits
projects.summary: Design and implement a board-level piezoelectric energy harvesting interface that performs maximum power point tracking, and verify it by measurements.

projects.title: A Board-Level Switched-Capacitor Stimulation Circuit
projects.summary: Design and implement an energy-efficient switched-capacitor stimulation circuit at board level and verify it by measurements.

projects.title: A High-Effectiveness Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting Interface Circuit
projects.summary: Design a piezoelectric energy harvesting interface circuit that stays efficient under varying vibration intensity, verified by transistor-level simulations.

projects.title: A High-Resolution Delta-Sigma ADC for Sensor-Interface Applications
projects.summary: Design a high-resolution, low-power first- or second-order delta-sigma ADC for life-science sensor interfaces, verified by pre- and post-layout transistor-level simulations.

projects.title: A Low-Power Digital Winner-Take-All (WTA) Circuit
projects.summary: Design a low-power digital winner-take-all circuit that identifies the largest input among several and verify it by transistor-level simulations.

projects.title: A Low-Power Multi-Channel Front-End Circuit for Biological Recording Systems
projects.summary: Design a low-power 8-channel recording front-end in which some blocks, such as the ADC, are shared between channels, and verify it by transistor-level simulations.

projects.title: A Multi-Phase High-Frequency Switched-Capacitor Neuro-Stimulation Circuit
projects.summary: Design an implantable, energy-efficient switched-capacitor neuro-stimulation circuit that avoids large off-chip capacitors, verified by transistor-level simulations.

projects.title: A Non-binary Search Successive Approximation Analog-to-Digital Converter for Biological Recording Systems
projects.summary: Design a highly linear, power-efficient non-binary search successive approximation ADC for biomedical and life-science applications, verified by pre- and post-layout simulations.

projects.title: An Integrator-Differentiator Transimpedance Amplifier for Nanopore Sensing Systems
projects.summary: Design a low-noise, highly linear integrator-differentiator transimpedance amplifier for nanopore sensing readout and verify it by transistor-level simulations in CMOS.

projects.title: Design and implementation of a digital reservoir computing system
projects.summary: Develop a digital processor dedicated to efficient reservoir computing, with a study of topology and architecture and a prototype on an FPGA.

projects.title: Design of a Microwave Class-E Power Amplifier with Microstrip-Line-Based RF Networks for Wireless Power Transfer Applications
projects.summary: Design and optimise a microwave Class-E power amplifier, around 2 GHz, with microstrip-line matching networks for wireless power transfer, evaluated by circuit-level simulations.

projects.title: Event-based (Neuromorphic) radar signal encodings
projects.summary: Industrial project with IMEC Holst Center (Neuromorphic Group) on encoding radar signals in an event-based, neuromorphic form.

projects.title: Internship at Lumiphase AG, Firmware and electronics development
projects.summary: Firmware and electronics development project at Lumiphase AG, offered as an MSc diploma project or an internship.

projects.title: Patient-specific implantable detection of seizure
projects.summary: Develop an FPGA-based processor with adaptable feature extractors and classifiers for patient-specific seizure detection in an implantable closed-loop stimulation system, including a test methodology.

projects.title: Peripherals for a AVR STK-300 environment
projects.summary: Develop assembly-level software libraries for additional peripheral boards of the AVR STK-300 microcontroller system, plus a PC graphical environment for displaying MCU sensor data sent over UART.

projects.title: Peripherals for an FPGA development environment
projects.summary: Create virtual analog and digital peripherals (accelerometer, VGA, UART) for the DE10-Lite FPGA board and integrate them into the logisim-evolution design flow, with a PC graphical environment for displaying sensor data.

projects.title: Reservoir computing for robust generation of complex temporal patterns
projects.summary: Study the robustness of reservoir computing networks to single or multiple fault events and parameter variations. The project develops a reservoir model, fault models and a strategy to counter faults, and analyses results on various waveforms.

projects.title: Self-Supervised fine-tuning of DNN in Edge AI processor
projects.summary: Industrial project with IMEC Holst Center (Neuromorphic Group) on self-supervised fine-tuning of deep neural networks on an edge AI processor.

projects.title: Wireless Power Transfer for Implantable Pacemakers at 2 GHz
projects.summary: Design and optimise a microwave wireless power transfer link at about 2 GHz with compact antennas (coils) for powering an implantable pacemaker, evaluated by full-wave simulations and possibly a prototype.

projects.title: Wireless Power Transfer for Ventricular Assist Devices (VADs) and Total Artificial Heart Systems (TAHs)
projects.summary: Design and optimise an inductive wireless power transfer link to supply implanted cardiac assist devices, studying coil geometry, frequency, coupling and compensation through electromagnetic and circuit simulations, with an optional prototype.

projects.title: Bioconjugation Strategies for Functional Molecular Probes
projects.summary: Optimize bioconjugation reaction conditions to obtain controlled stoichiometry in DNA-protein conjugates used for biomolecular sensing. The student works on protein biochemistry, molecular characterization and gel electrophoresis.

projects.title: DNA Nanotechnology for Spatial Biochemical Sensing
projects.summary: Engineer custom DNA molecular switches for localized biochemical monitoring and characterize their responsiveness with fluorescence-based assays.

projects.title: Nanostructured DNA-Protein Architectures for Biosensing
projects.summary: Design structural DNA-protein architectures for sensitive detection of biomarker targets. The student screens architecture designs and characterizes their functional interactions using optical readout methods.

projects.title: Neurotransmitter Sensing using Organic Transistors
projects.summary: Build new designs and configurations of organic electrochemical transistors (OECTs) to measure neurotransmitters for biosensing and neurotechnology applications.

projects.title: Analog waveform generation for future Point-of-Care Dielectrophoretic devices
projects.summary: Design a compact, programmable multi-channel analog waveform generator for the control signals of a 3D-micropillar dielectrophoresis (DEP) platform. The target is at least 6 channels covering 10 kHz to 30 MHz (ideally up to 50 MHz) and 1 V to 40 V, with a literature review, electromagnetic simulations of electrode traces, circuit design, firmware, and validation in DEP particle separation experiments.

projects.title: Development of a DLD-Based Platform for Enrichment of Cell-Cell Pairs
projects.summary: Develop a Deterministic Lateral Displacement (DLD) microfluidic platform to label-free enrich cell-cell doublets, building on an existing lab device. The work covers redesigning the array geometry and sorting size, minimizing shear-induced disruption, and validating enrichment efficiency and doublet integrity against FACS-based protocols.

projects.title: Evaluating the Biological Impact of Electric Fields in Microfluidic Cell Manipulation Platforms
projects.summary: The project investigates the biological effects of electric-field exposure on mammalian cells in microfluidic electrokinetic platforms, such as electrorotation and dielectrophoresis devices. The student will develop fluorescence-based assays to monitor cell viability, apoptosis, ROS generation and thermal effects before, during and after field exposure.

projects.title: Separation of primary cell adipocytes by Deterministic Lateral Displacement
projects.summary: Develop a novel Deterministic Lateral Displacement (DLD) microfluidic platform to sort primary adipocytes from human tissue biopsies, adapting an existing lab device and optimising tissue digestion and pre-processing. The work is carried out jointly with the Naveiras group at UNIL.

projects.title: A universal engine for the calculation of structural properties of materials
projects.summary: Extend the i-PI Python interface so that it can perform routine and advanced calculations of structural material properties such as equilibrium geometry and elastic constants, making these algorithms available to any energy and force engine.

projects.title: Advanced atomistic simulations: theory and implementation
projects.summary: Study, benchmark and document one of the methods implemented in the i-PI universal force engine for atomistic materials simulations. Suited to students with little background in atomistic modelling and programming.

projects.title: Auto-Correlation Analysis of Atomistic Simulations
projects.summary: Extend and generalise the COSMO toolbox, a C++ library for efficient autocorrelation analysis, into a modular package that can interface with popular molecular simulation codes. Autocorrelation is used to de-correlate order parameters and to monitor time-dependent quantities such as diffusion coefficients and hydrogen-bond lifetimes.

projects.title: Automatic Recognition of Molecular Motifs
projects.summary: Translate the existing FORTRAN implementation of PAMM, a clustering technique for recurring molecular structural motifs, into modern scikit-learn-style Python modules within the scikit-cosmo package.

projects.title: Making molecular dynamics more efficient
projects.summary: The project aims to bridge the gap between the very short integration time step of molecular dynamics and the much longer time scales of phenomena such as chemical reactions and phase transitions. It will investigate either correlated-noise Langevin dynamics to explore configuration space more efficiently, or adapting the simulation time step to the different time scales present in the system.

projects.title: Visualizing structure-property relations in materials
projects.summary: Work with chemiscope, an online tool for exploring materials and molecular databases, by adding features, implementing data analytics on structural data, and applying the tool to computational materials discovery problems.

projects.title: Chewing Robot with Sensorimotor, CPG and EMG Control
projects.summary: Control a 6-DOF chewing robot (mouth, jaw and teeth) to reproduce human chewing movements, monitored with force sensors and cameras. The project includes CPG and PID control and EMG signal processing, with possible integration of artificial saliva and a soft tongue.

projects.title: Crevasse-Climbing Robot for Alpine Environments
projects.summary: Redesign and experimentally validate a robot that climbs inside crevasses, improving mass distribution, adding a stabilisation mechanism against drift, and tolerating non-parallel walls. The final goal is a field-capable prototype demonstrated in a real Alpine crevasse.

projects.title: Lati-gami Heart, a Programmable Soft Robotic Heart Simulator for Valve Repair and Pathology Studies
projects.summary: Build a soft robotic heart simulator from origami structures and programmable 3D-printed lattices, whose disease state can be programmed to study cardiac pathologies and test heart valve repair strategies in vitro.

projects.title: Lattice Trunk, an Elephant-Inspired Soft Manipulator that Bends, Twists and Feels
projects.summary: Develop an elephant-trunk-inspired soft manipulator printed as one piece of programmable lattice, with embedded sensing for contact, pressure and shear. The trunk will be mounted on a tendon-driven base and used for wrapping, pinching and picking tasks.
skills: motors and sensors (Dynamixel, ESP32/Arduino) a plus

projects.title: Mechanical Design of an Underactuated Hand with Integrated Variable Stiffness Actuation
projects.summary: Design and 3D-print a compact underactuated finger or hand that integrates series and parallel variable stiffness actuator layouts, with springs, tendon routing and motors packaged within hand size limits. The work includes CAD sizing and prototype characterisation.

projects.title: Port-Hamiltonian Virtual Model Control of a Soft Arm with Learned Passive Dynamics
projects.summary: Learn the configuration-dependent dynamics of a tendon-driven soft arm with a passivity-preserving port-Hamiltonian neural model, then optimise the virtual model control parameters on the learned model. The approach is validated on reaching and contact tasks against hand-tuned baselines.

projects.title: Programmable thermochromic skin with sensorimotor control
projects.summary: Develop a multi-modal artificial skin with integrated sensing (color, temperature, proprioception) and programmable thermochromic heating, for robot-environment interaction and wearable gloves. The project covers electronics, sensor interfacing and data acquisition.

projects.title: Rail switching in a multi-robot system: transfer mechanism design and fleet path allocation
projects.summary: Design and prototype a mechanical switch that moves rail carriages between rails at a junction, and develop a planning layer that allocates routes to the fleet without collisions or deadlocks. Validation is done on the lab's rail robot platform.

projects.title: Robotic data center maintenance, Imitation learning
projects.summary: Train a robotic arm to perform data center maintenance tasks, starting with hard-drive swaps on a mock server rack. Demonstrations are collected by teleoperation and imitation learning policies are trained from visual observations, then validated on a real robot.

projects.title: Robotic functional testing of surgical instruments
projects.summary: Automate the functional pass/fail testing of surgical instruments with a robotic arm that actuates each tool and uses force, torque and camera data. A machine learning layer will classify healthy versus worn instruments.

projects.title: Robotic Tongue and Lip-Dependent Speech Expression
projects.summary: Design a soft robotic oral cavity with a tongue that can replicate human tongue motions to produce articulate speech sounds, coordinated with lip expression. The work includes robot design, actuator and sensor integration, and sound data analysis.

projects.title: Tendon-driven Soft Robotic Stomach
projects.summary: Design and prototype a minimalistic tendon-driven soft robotic stomach that reproduces the mechanical motions of human digestion, based on a review of existing artificial stomach designs.

projects.title: A Framework for Carbon Flow Tracing in Swiss Power Distribution Grids
projects.summary: Enhance an existing framework that estimates the carbon content of electricity in medium and low voltage grids by combining public electricity market data with local factors. The student extends the framework to model carbon flows in MV grids and to include additional generation technologies beyond solar.

projects.title: Design and Experimental Validation of an Electromagnetic Levitation Controller for a Hyperloop Pod
projects.summary: Design, implement and experimentally validate a control algorithm for the electromagnetic levitation of a Hyperloop pod, stabilising heave, pitch and roll and tracking a desired air-gap trajectory. The project includes modelling, simulation, implementation on the pod's sbRIO FPGA, and, in a second phase, decoupled propulsion-levitation control tested on the epfloop circular infrastructure.

projects.title: Dynamic modelling and real time simulation of a transmission network
projects.summary: Build a dynamic model of a portion of a real transmission network in MATLAB/Simulink, structure it for real-time simulation with RT-lab, and validate the implementation through a real-time simulation.

projects.title: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy for battery health diagnostics in aviation applications
projects.summary: Investigates how far electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) can be used with external, non-invasive instrumentation to diagnose aviation-grade battery modules. It covers detecting a single defective cell within a healthy module and using high-frequency EIS as a proxy for a cell's internal temperature.

projects.title: Electronics Upgrade and Electromagnetic Compatibility of a Reduced Scale Hyperloop Pod
projects.summary: Improve the onboard electronics of the reduced scale epfloop hyperloop pod, with a focus on characterising and mitigating electromagnetic interference that degrades analogue sensor measurements. The work also covers redesigning the electronics (including replacing the onboard controller and PCB design) and improving the battery energy storage system current measurement.

projects.title: Incipient Fault Detection Using Waveform Analysis
projects.summary: The project investigates waveform-based methods for detecting incipient faults, which are low-magnitude, developing anomalies that can precede permanent faults in power systems. It aims to review state-of-the-art techniques, propose an improved detection method, and validate it through simulations and case studies.

projects.title: Mechanical Modelling and Characterisation of a Reduced-Scale Hyperloop Pod for Levitation Control
projects.summary: Model and characterise the mechanics of the epfloop hyperloop pod, including mass properties, chassis flexibility and vibration modes, and improve chassis rigidity and test-bench stability. The student will also design a setup to measure the static levitation force of a levitation unit and validate the existing electromagnetic model.

projects.title: Phase Identification in medium voltage network
projects.summary: Develop and evaluate algorithms for automatic phase identification in medium-voltage networks using real PMU voltage and current phasor measurements from primary and secondary substations. The work includes reviewing existing methods, implementing new algorithms in Python, validating them on PMU datasets with ground truth, and testing performance with distributed generation.

projects.title: PMU - based oscillation detection, characterization and source identification
projects.summary: Develop a data-driven framework using Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) data to detect power system oscillations, estimate their modal characteristics (frequency, damping, mode shape), and identify their likely source. The project covers methods such as Prony analysis, spectral methods and machine learning, evaluated on synthetic or real PMU datasets.
skills: signal processing (FFT, Prony, wavelet, spectral analysis)

projects.title: Régimes de neutre pour un réseau de distribution moyenne tension
projects.summary: Comparative study of neutral-earthing regimes for a medium-voltage distribution network that Services Industriels de Lausanne plans to raise from 11.5 kV to 21 kV. The student models a representative network in Pandapower, simulates single-phase earth faults and protection impacts, and recommends a solution for SiL.

projects.title: Self-aware load control for ex-post grid tariffs: Design and field-test on the EPFL smart-grid platform
projects.summary: Design a self-aware load-control algorithm that recognises its own contribution to grid load and forecasts the ex-post tariff its dispatch helps create, then test it first in simulation and then on the EPFL smart-grid demonstrator. The work studies rebound peaks caused by automated price-responsive loads under ex-post distribution grid tariffs.

projects.title: Advanced magneto-optic detection
projects.summary: A technical TP IV project on developing advanced magneto-optic detection methods for the laboratory's experiments. Students should contact Gregor Jotzu directly.

projects.title: Fast laser beam modulator
projects.summary: A technical TP IV project to build a fast modulator for the laser beam used in the laboratory's ultrafast optics experiments. Students should contact Gregor Jotzu directly.

projects.title: Flexible cryogenic heat link
projects.summary: A technical TP IV project to set up a flexible cryogenic heat link for the laboratory's low-temperature experiments. Students should contact Gregor Jotzu directly.

projects.title: Optical Control of Quantized Magnetic Flux
projects.summary: The student joins experiments that use ultrafast intense laser pulses to locally destroy superconductivity in a ring-shaped superconductor, aiming to add or remove single flux quanta and probing the trapped magnetic field with optical magnetometry. The work may include simulations or help with scientific instrumentation.

projects.title: Real Magnetic Fields from Quantum Materials Driven by Bright Circularly Polarized Terahertz Pulses
projects.summary: The student joins experiments that use circularly polarized THz pulses to resonantly drive chiral phonons and test whether they generate a real magnetic field around the sample, using new optical magnetometry methods. The work may include calculations, simulations, or help with scientific instrumentation.

projects.title: Buckling analysis of arcs using a local probing technique
projects.summary: Investigates the buckling of clamped semi-circular carbon-fiber arcs under a point force, using a poker-based nondestructive probing technique that tracks the basin of attraction and stability landscape. The goals are to study the effect of imperfections on edge states and to determine when the probing technique reliably predicts the spontaneous buckling load.

projects.title: Analyse théorique et expérimentale de couplage entre conducteurs parallèles
projects.summary: Theoretical and experimental study of electromagnetic coupling between parallel conductors.

projects.title: Comparison of lightning characteristics over land and ocean
projects.summary: Use geostationary satellite data over the Americas to estimate the number, energy and spatial coverage of lightning flashes in 20-second windows, and statistically compare these parameters between land and ocean.

projects.title: Conception et réalisation de démonstrations en rapport avec le cours de compatibilité électromagnétique
projects.summary: Design and build demonstrations illustrating the electromagnetic compatibility course content.

projects.title: Design of an electric field sensor for the measurement of lightning electric field
projects.summary: Design and laboratory calibration of a wideband electric field sensor for lightning discharges, using a flat plate antenna connected to two electronic integrators with different sensitivity and measuring range.

projects.title: Development of portable impulse generator with output up to 1 kV
projects.summary: Develop a portable voltage generator producing impulse-shaped output, with a rapid rise to peak in a few microseconds and decay in tens to hundreds of microseconds, to test the lightning-transient response of equipment such as transformers, cables and grounding systems. The generator uses a voltage multiplier and a MOSFET electronic switch.

projects.title: Développement d’un programme de simulation du rayonnement électromagnétique d’un canal de foudre
projects.summary: Develop a simulation program for the electromagnetic radiation emitted by a lightning channel.

projects.title: DORT-Based Method Applied to Locating Resistive electrical faults
projects.summary: Study the DORT (time-reversal operator decomposition) theory and develop a DORT-based method to locate resistive, high-impedance electrical faults in wired systems, where existing EMTR methods struggle.

projects.title: Enabling low-cost far-field imaging thanks to electromagnetic time-reversal and software-defined radios
projects.summary: Build an experimental platform that uses software-defined radios and electromagnetic time reversal to localise radiation sources in the far field at low cost. The work addresses the challenges of generating radio-frequency signals with SDRs.

projects.title: High Voltage and High Frequency Unipolar Connector
projects.summary: Develop a numerical model of a high-voltage, high-frequency unipolar connector proposed by LEMO, to improve its withstand voltage and partial discharge performance. The project is co-supervised by LEMO.

projects.title: Lightning current waveform analysis
projects.summary: Investigate how the lightning channel-base current waveshape depends on channel geometry, using recordings and measurements from the Säntis Observatory (current waveform recording, broadband interferometry and high-speed video).

projects.title: Localisation of multi electromagnetic sources using electromagnetic time reversal (EMTR) and machine learning (ML)
projects.summary: Localise multiple electromagnetic sources inside a medium by combining electromagnetic time reversal with convolutional neural networks, using data from multiple electric or magnetic sensors.

projects.title: Méthodes de calcul et de mesure des paramètres des lignes multiconductrices
projects.summary: Methods for computing and measuring the parameters of multiconductor transmission lines.

projects.title: Numerical Validation of Electromagnetic Time Reversal for Geolocation of Lightning Strike Using 3D-FDTD
projects.summary: Extend a 2D-FDTD electromagnetic time reversal algorithm for lightning return stroke localisation to 3D, so that lossy ground, terrain and antenna directivity are modelled. The project also explores 1-bit time reversal and clipping techniques.

projects.title: Numerical Validation of Electromagnetic Time Reversal for Partial Discharge in Power Transformers Using Green's Functions
projects.summary: Use Green's functions instead of FDTD or FEM to detect partial discharges in power transformers via electromagnetic time reversal, with the aim of significantly reducing computation times.

projects.title: Simulation and Scaled Model Measurements of Grounding Systems in Elevated Terrain
projects.summary: Investigate, through simulations and measurements on a reduced-scale model, how non-flat terrain affects the grounding resistance of structures such as telecommunication towers and wind turbines. The student is provided with the measurement setup and simulation framework.

projects.title: Microarchitectural explorations for biomedical applications
projects.summary: Explore whether an in-order superscalar RISC-V core (CV32E20) instead of the current single-issue core in X-HEEP can improve energy efficiency for the BiomedBench biomedical wearable applications. The student will build a lightweight RISC-V simulator, generate execution traces, model superscalar execution, and later assess power overheads.

projects.title: Bubble-free water electrolysis
projects.summary: Design and optimize a bubble-free, capillarity-driven flow cell for electrolysis. The project examines how different electrodes and membranes, with various geometries and materials, affect performance.

projects.title: Collective bubble behavior in boiling
projects.summary: Aims to understand and control collective bubble behavior to explore boiling physics and improve nucleation reliability.

projects.title: Controlled vapor sorption and smart water release
projects.summary: Studies hygroscopic metal organic framework (MOF)-based materials, which are promising for energy-efficient cooling and water harvesting. The focus is on controlled vapor sorption and water release.

projects.title: Hydrogel Overlayer on Metal Scaffold (HOMeS)
projects.summary: Investigates hydrogel overlayers on metal scaffolds for cooling.

projects.title: Modeling energy savings of passive cooling panels
projects.summary: Quantifies annual building-level energy savings of passive cooling panels across diverse climates and integration pathways. It also compares the net benefit of these panels against PV cells to guide technology selection.

projects.title: Probing contamination in microscale porous evaporator
projects.summary: Aims to investigate the accumulation of impurities in a microscale porous evaporator non-invasively, using advanced metrology and spectroscopy.

projects.title: Fabrication of microchannels for thin film dewetting
projects.summary: Study liquid film dewetting on rough microtextured substrates by fabricating microtextured silicon or silica surfaces with lithography and etching, coating them with thin films, and analysing dewetting of chalcogenide glass.

projects.title: New fabrication methods for metallic and all-dielectric nano-object arrays
projects.summary: Investigate a simple and scalable nano-imprint and thin-film approach to fabricate 2D and 3D ordered arrays of metallic and all-dielectric nano-objects.

projects.title: Soft fibers for actuation and robotic
projects.summary: Develop new elastomer-based soft composite materials for thermally drawn multi-material fibers that can sense and adapt to their environment, with applications in soft robotics and wearable devices.

projects.title: 3D Modeling (with CFD and Heat transfer) of a Solid Oxide Electrolyzer for Syngas Production
projects.summary: Build and validate a steady-state COMSOL model of a solid oxide electrolysis cell operated in co-electrolysis of H₂O and CO₂ to produce syngas. The project then uses the validated model to study how temperature, inlet H₂O:CO₂ ratio and current density affect outlet H₂:CO ratio and cell efficiency.

projects.title: Accelerated Stress Tests for Anion Exchange Membrane Water Electrolyzers
projects.summary: The project aims to conduct accelerated stress tests (ASTs) under adverse conditions such as high currents, voltages, temperatures, KOH concentration and cyclic loading to study degradation of the anodic porous transport layer in anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers. It is part of the HyPrAEM Horizon Europe project and its results feed long-term stack testing.

projects.title: AEMWE Bubble Imaging Setup
projects.summary: Build an imaging setup with a high-speed camera and transparent endplates to record hydrogen and oxygen bubble evolution in an anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer (AEMWE) as a function of applied current. Segment the bubbles and compute their properties, such as size distribution and occupied volume, and repeat for different porous transport layer (PTL) configurations.

projects.title: Ammonia to electricity: performance and stability of a Solid Oxide Fuel Cell
projects.summary: Investigate the direct use of ammonia in a Solid Oxide Fuel Cell by screening a single cell under varied temperature, fuel utilization and gas composition, assessing ammonia's effect on performance and degradation using cyclic voltammetry, EIS, and gas analysis. The work is within the EU AMON project.

projects.title: CFD Simulation: Two-Phase Flow in Porous Media
projects.summary: CFD simulations of two-phase (gas bubble) flow in porous transport layers of anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers, varying microstructure properties such as porosity and permeability and adding a porosity gradient via an intermediate microporous layer, to help optimise the PTL microstructure. The work includes improving an existing multi-physics model developed in the lab.

projects.title: Characterization of Sorbents for Hot Gas Desulfurization in Biogas-Fueled SOFC Systems
projects.summary: Evaluate various sorbents for hydrogen sulfide removal from contaminated biogas under different temperatures and gas flow rates, to identify the most effective sorbents and optimal hot gas desulfurization conditions compatible with SOFC operation. The work includes a literature review and experimental characterization of selected sorbents.

projects.title: Continuous Solvo-Chemical Reactor
projects.summary: Develop a continuous solvo-chemical reactor.

projects.title: Deep learning and neural network approaches for Solid Oxide Cell based Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy analysis
projects.summary: Study how deep learning and neural network methods can analyse solid oxide cell electrochemical impedance spectroscopy data, including curve smoothing, noise removal, and separating electrochemical processes to quantify their resistances, building on existing DRT, equivalent circuit and CNLS fit methods.

projects.title: Design and Experimental Validation of Electrochemical Models Using a Reference-Electrode Setup
projects.summary: The project focuses on designing and using a reference-electrode setup to independently measure anode and cathode potentials in an anion exchange membrane electrolyser operated with direct seawater. The experimental data will be used to validate separate anode and cathode electrochemical models.

projects.title: Effect of the dispersion protocol on the colloidal stability of PEMFC inks
projects.summary: The project investigates how the dispersion protocol affects the colloidal stability of PEM fuel cell catalyst inks. The student evaluates agglomeration kinetics over time through particle size analysis and zeta potential measurements, after selecting solvent mixture and ionomer content from the literature.

projects.title: Electrochemical Simulation of an Electrolyzer
projects.summary: Simulate the electrochemical behaviour of an electrolyzer.

projects.title: Engineering a Corrosion-Resistant Stack for Direct Seawater Electrolysis
projects.summary: The project develops corrosion-resistant and lightweight stack components for direct seawater electrolysis. It combines a literature review and corrosion testing of materials and coatings on an existing test bench with the design and prototyping of polymer-based stack parts and ways to integrate electrical current paths into them.

projects.title: Evaluating the effect of the dispersion media on the colloidal stability in catalyst inks for PEMFC
projects.summary: Investigate how different solvent mixtures and ionomer contents affect the colloidal stability of Pt-C catalyst inks for PEM fuel cells, using zeta-potential and particle size (DLS) measurements, with xDLVO calculations for validation.

projects.title: Experimental characterization of metal hydride cells under challenging conditions
projects.summary: Experimentally characterise metal hydride cells under demanding operating conditions.

projects.title: Fast EIS Development of a new technique for fast electrochemical impedance spectroscopy
projects.summary: Develop a new technique that allows electrochemical impedance spectroscopy to be measured faster.

projects.title: Kinetic Modeling of Hot Gas Desulfurization for Biogas-Fueled SOFC Systems
projects.summary: Develop a dynamic 0D kinetic model of a fixed-bed hot gas desulfurization reactor that predicts H2S breakthrough curves for multicomponent biogas as a function of temperature, gas composition, flow rate and sorbent type. The model will be benchmarked against experimental breakthrough data generated in parallel, to support the protection of solid oxide fuel cells from sulfur poisoning.

projects.title: Life Cycle Assessment of Hydrogen Generation by the emerging Electrolyzer Technologies
projects.summary: Build a life cycle assessment model of the manufacturing of anion exchange membrane (AEM) and proton conducting ceramic cell (PCC) electrolyzers in OpenLCA, identify the key manufacturing steps driving emissions, and run sensitivity analyses on scenarios such as material recycling rate and energy source.

projects.title: Lock-In Thermography for Identification of Bubble Production Hot Spots
projects.summary: Study how oxygen bubbles trapped in the porous transport layers of anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers affect cell efficiency, using lock-in thermography to locate bubble accumulation hot spots and inform cell design and PTL design.

projects.title: Magnetotomography: Investigation on a new method for fuel cell current density distribution measurement
projects.summary: Reconstruct the internal 2D current density distribution of a fuel cell MEA from external magnetic field measurements taken with small magnetometers. The work combines a literature review, numerical inverse-problem solving, and validation on a 3x3 wire array with controlled currents.

projects.title: Modelling of Parasitic Electrolyzer Currents
projects.summary: Model the parasitic currents that occur in electrolyzers.

projects.title: Physics-based Modeling of PEM Fuel Cell Systems using Modelica
projects.summary: Develop and refine a dynamic PEM fuel cell system model in Modelica/OpenModelica, covering stack voltage losses, gas utilization, balance of plant (air, hydrogen, cooling), feedback control, and validation against manufacturer and load data. The work is done in collaboration with GEM and IPESE.

projects.title: Solid Oxide Cell based Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Dataset for Deep Learning and Neural Network Applications
projects.summary: Build the first solid oxide cell (SOC) electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) dataset from GEM's historical data and literature, to support deep learning and neural networks that separate the electrochemical processes inside the cell. The work includes a literature review, data collection, and building a pandas-based dataset in Python.

projects.title: Structural Mechanics Study for a Pressurized AEMWE Stack
projects.summary: Study the structural mechanics of a 500 cm2 circular anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer (AEMWE) stack, integrating a new circular flow channel design into the existing model. The goal is to optimize the stack design for operation at 100 bar as part of scaling up to 100 kW.

projects.title: Surrogate model development for of a water electrolyzer using deep learning
projects.summary: Improve a deep neural network surrogate model of an anion exchange membrane water electrolyzer (AEMWE) by adding more electrolyzer parameters and using real experimental data. The goal is faster, more accurate efficiency predictions for new operating conditions, to support long-term control and a future digital twin.

projects.title: System modeling and optimization of co-SOE/FT system for e-fuels production
projects.summary: The project covers system-level modeling and optimization of a co-electrolysis (co-SOE) and Fischer-Tropsch (FT) system that converts renewable electricity, steam and CO into syngas for e-fuels and sustainable aviation fuel. It includes multi-objective optimization and uncertainty and sensitivity analyses, with attention to heat integration, cell degradation and coking. The work is done in collaboration with GEM and IPESE.

projects.title: System modeling and optimization of co-SOE/FT system for e-fuels production – TEA/LCA
projects.summary: Perform a techno-economic and life cycle assessment of a combined solid oxide electrolysis and Fischer-Tropsch system for e-fuels production.

projects.title: Valorization of cheese whey in a bio-electrolysis stack
projects.summary: Valorise cheese whey as feedstock in a bio-electrolysis stack.

projects.title: Data-driven Network Reduction for Electrical Distribution Networks for TSO-DSO Coordination
projects.summary: Develop data-driven techniques to reduce the complexity of electrical distribution network models while preserving the operational characteristics needed for TSO-DSO coordination. The reduced-order models are to be evaluated for accuracy, computational efficiency, and suitability for congestion management, flexibility assessment and voltage stability analysis.

projects.title: Dynamic Operating Envelopes Using Voltage Sensitivity for Distribution Networks
projects.summary: Develop a framework for computing dynamic operating envelopes in distribution networks that combines local voltage measurements with voltage sensitivity information to define adaptive, risk-aware, real-time limits on DER power injection or consumption. The work includes a baseline DOE implementation, a feedback-based DOE design, and performance comparison on a distribution grid model.

projects.title: Extrapolation and Directional Anisotropic Behavior of Neural Operators for Power-Flow Applications
projects.summary: Study how neural network and physics-informed neural network surrogates for power flow and optimal power flow solvers extrapolate beyond their training regions. The goal is to quantify the reliability radius of these surrogates, its directional anisotropy, and its scaling with network width and depth.

projects.title: Fair and Efficient Optimization of Distribution Grid Interconnection Queues Using Flexible Connection Agreements
projects.summary: Develop and test an optimization-based framework for allocating scarce distribution-grid capacity among queued DER connection projects. The work explores flexible or curtailable connection agreements to increase connected projects while maintaining network security and fairness.

projects.title: Grid-Aware, Fair and Adaptive Formation of Local Energy Communities
projects.summary: Develop a scalable method that recommends which buildings should form a local energy community, how benefits are shared, and how the community adapts as members change. The approach combines coalition formation, fair benefit sharing (Shapley, nucleolus, pro-rata) and optimisation-based control of heat pumps, storage and EVs within distribution system operator limits.

projects.title: LLM-Evolved Repair Layers for Neural Optimal Power Flow Proxies
projects.summary: Uses large language models in an evolutionary program-search loop to design repair procedures that turn neural-network optimal power flow proxy outputs into feasible operating points. The goal is to restore AC feasibility faster and closer to optimality than hand-designed repairs, and to test whether the evolved programs transfer across grids, proxies and operating conditions.

projects.title: Optimal PV Feed-in Limits in Swiss Distribution Grids: Trading off Curtailment Remuneration against Grid Reinforcement
projects.summary: Develop an optimization-based planning framework to find the optimal PV feed-in limit k* in Swiss distribution grids, minimising the DSO's curtailment remuneration cost plus grid reinforcement capex. The approach uses a two-stage stochastic MILP with LinDistFlow constraints and compares fixed-tariff, spot, and DLMP remuneration.

projects.title: Physics-Grounded RAG-Enhanced LLM Agents for Reliable Power-System Simulation, Optimization, and Security Assessment
projects.summary: Develop an agentic AI framework in which LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and power-system simulation tools (e.g. pandapower) answer natural-language requests such as power flow, optimal power flow and N-1 contingency analysis, with physics-based validation of the results and explanatory reports.

projects.title: Bubble vortex breakdown in a cylindrical cavity
projects.summary: Studies the base flow and axisymmetric stability of a swirling flow in a cylindrical cavity with a small second-phase bubble on the axis. Numerical simulations (COMSOL or Basilisk) are used to determine parameter ranges (Reynolds, Froude, Weber numbers and aspect ratio) that sustain a stable bubble.

projects.title: Stability of Gravity Jets
projects.summary: Investigates the dynamics of a horizontal jet of heavy salt water injected into lighter fresh water, which is relevant to pollutant dispersion and outfall design. The work combines theoretical analysis and OpenFOAM numerical simulations to clarify how trajectory, dilution and mixing depend on the Richardson number.

projects.title: Wind driven rotating sloshing waves in hydro turbine draft tube
projects.summary: Develops a theoretical description of the wind-driven free-surface sloshing wave in a partially filled hydro turbine draft tube operating in condenser mode. The work starts from linear stability analysis of gravity waves under parallel air flow and extends it to a cylindrical geometry to study azimuthal modes.

projects.title: Cryogenic study of millimeter-wave/terahertz integrated chips
projects.summary: Characterise millimeter-wave and terahertz photonic integrated circuits on thin-film lithium niobate at cryogenic temperatures (4 K or below) using a cryostat or dilution refrigerator. The work involves designing microwave and fiber-based optical setups inside the cryostat.

projects.title: Designing and simulation of phase-matched THz transmission line on fully etched thin-film lithium niobate
projects.summary: Design a new integrated THz device structure with a phase-matched transmission line on a fully etched thin-film lithium niobate waveguide (about 600 nm) to avoid the crosstalk and interference signal seen in partly etched (about 300 nm) designs. The work includes simulation of the device.

projects.title: Development of a heterodyne detection system
projects.summary: Develop a heterodyne detection system that mixes a monochromatic reference laser with unknown light on a photodetector, so that the resulting AC voltage can be used to characterise the spectrum of the light under test. The work includes a systematic study of measurement characteristics across hardware and software configurations.

projects.title: Periodically Poled Lithium Niobate Waveguides
projects.summary: Design, simulate and characterize periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) waveguides for second harmonic generation, for applications in quantum technologies and telecommunications. The student would also work on poling stations and optical characterization setups.

projects.title: Shape Light with Nanostructures – Semester Project in Ultrafast Photonics
projects.summary: Design, simulate and experimentally characterize photonic nanostructures that control the phase and amplitude of femtosecond laser pulses. Simulated nanostructures are to be fabricated at CMI and tested by reconstructing the shaped pulse with FROG.

projects.title: Accurate movement trajectory decoding for high-performance brain-machine interfaces
projects.summary: Build a regressor that decodes continuous movement trajectories (hand and finger positions) from ECoG and/or spiking activity in patients. Students will study neural biomarkers and implement feature-engineered and end-to-end machine learning models.

projects.title: Circuit Design and Verification for a Low-Power Neural Network Accelerator for Neural Decoding
projects.summary: Design and verify low-power, near-threshold circuits, including a level shifter and SRAM, for a neural network accelerator used in neuromodulation systems. Students will review literature, define specifications with PhD researchers, and evaluate a fabricated integrated circuit.

projects.title: Circuit design for stimulation artifact cancellation in concurrent neural recording and stimulation
projects.summary: Design artifact cancellation circuits in Cadence to remove large stimulation artifacts from low-amplitude neural recordings during concurrent recording and stimulation. Students will explore algorithms and hardware architectures, assess complexity, and help design and test prototype integrated circuits.

projects.title: Detecting mental fatigue and symptoms of psychiatric disorders from continuous neuronal recordings
projects.summary: Explore machine learning tools to detect the onset of mental fatigue and neuropsychiatric symptoms from multi-channel ECoG and LFP recordings in primates (and possibly humans). Students will study biomarkers and optimize classifiers for accuracy and latency.

projects.title: Exploring Mimed and Covert Speech Decoding from EEG
projects.summary: Design and validate an EEG experiment for mimed and covert speech, collect a dataset, and assess the feasibility of decoding a small vocabulary. The project also studies which electrode locations and reduced channel configurations are most informative for speech decoding. It is designed for two students, each responsible for one speech condition.

projects.title: Exploring Representation Learning for Neural Signal Decoders
projects.summary: Improve representation learning for neural signal decoders, such as vector-quantization on transformer-based neural foundation models or self-supervised methods, to decode ECoG signals from movement attempts for a Brain Spine Interface. Detailed objectives are flexible and can be discussed.

projects.title: Machine learning chip design for on-implant neural decoding
projects.summary: Design an efficient feature extraction and/or machine learning processor that classifies or decodes neural data in real time on implants, with low power and small area. Students will design candidate algorithms in Cadence and assess hardware complexity with simulations, then help test prototype integrated circuits.

projects.title: Patient-Independent Seizure Detection from Intracranial EEG
projects.summary: Develop deep learning methods for seizure detection from intracranial EEG that generalize across patients. Students will evaluate models on public datasets and study how learned neural representations improve robustness and cross-subject generalization.

projects.title: Resource-efficient machine learning algorithm design for on-implant neurological symptom detection
projects.summary: Develop efficient machine learning models that process electrophysiological data (scalp EEG, ECoG, spikes) in real time with low power, small on-chip area and fast inference for neurological symptom detection on implants. Students will implement models, evaluate them, and estimate hardware complexity.

projects.title: Speech Decoding for Brain-Computer Interfaces
projects.summary: Develop and evaluate deep learning models that decode speech from neural activity for speech BCIs. The project explores strategies to improve generalization across sessions or conditions and analyzes learned neural representations.

projects.title: Advanced Flexure-Mechanism Design
projects.summary: Develop a new design and modelling framework for flexure-based mechanisms that addresses several performance criteria at once and robustness to manufacturing tolerances. The work includes literature review, analytical and numerical modelling, design, and experimental validation. The project is a Master's project from January 2027 to August 2027, with an option to continue as a PhD thesis from October 2027.

projects.title: Biomimetic Mechanical Sound Generation
projects.summary: Design a new biomimetic sound-producing mechanism inspired by cricket stridulation, for applications such as watch alarms or musical instruments. The project offers either mechanical design and manufacturing of a prototype, or physical modelling of the stridulation principle.

projects.title: Design of a new musical instrument: acoustic simulation and modeling of sound generation through stick and slip, followed by prototyping
projects.summary: Simulate a new type of musical instrument based on stick-slip sound generation and model its acoustics. Depending on the student's profile, the project can also include mechanical design and prototyping to test the theoretical predictions.

projects.title: Flexure based surgical tool
projects.summary: Develop a flexible flexure-based structure for a micro-surgical tool providing two rotational degrees of freedom, with a gripper or other end effector adapted to the medical application. The tool should be usable with manual or robotic actuation.

projects.title: Mechanical analog computation with flexures mechanisms
projects.summary: Develop new miniaturized fully mechanical computing modules based on flexure mechanisms, as an alternative to electronic computing for extreme environments. The work covers mechanical design, modelling, simulation and prototyping, with possible development of digital logic families.

projects.title: Rotoprinter 1 – Interface material for 3D printing
projects.summary: Experimentally compare interface materials for 3D printing. The project is part of the Rotoprinter line of work on additive manufacturing.

projects.title: Surgical knot tension measurement device
projects.summary: Design and prototype a handheld or table-mounted mechanical device that measures the pretension applied when tying surgical knots, with a tunable force-limitation system and ergonomic design. The device is intended for surgeon training and evaluation, and is validated with different filaments and knots. The project can be a semester project or a master's thesis.

projects.title: Contextual data-driven robust control with conformal prediction
projects.summary: Develop a contextual data-driven robust control framework that builds context-dependent uncertainty sets from historical data using conformal prediction, with coverage guarantees for the disturbance. The work includes theory and validation on benchmark control tasks.

projects.title: Data-driven adaptive control of an active suspension test bench
projects.summary: Set up an active suspension test bench and apply data-driven adaptive control techniques to it. The controller should be robust to parametric uncertainties and will be verified on the test bench.

projects.title: Digital twin of an industrial thermal process with neural optimal control
projects.summary: Build a digital twin simulator of an industrial thermal process (e.g. oven, dryer or reactor) with a PID controller in the loop. Then apply neural-network optimal control methods to outperform the baseline PID controller.

projects.title: Distributionally robust control within data-driven controller synthesis
projects.summary: Extend the lab's data-driven controller synthesis framework with Distributionally Robust Control (DRO) objectives. The work includes theory, implementation in the datadriven library, and experimental validation on lab systems with saturation-related constraints.

projects.title: EPFL babyfoot ball handling and control improvement
projects.summary: Improve the ball handling of the EPFL babyfoot robot so it can capture a moving ball, pass it, juggle, and shoot toward the opponent goal. Students may also propose their own improvements.

projects.title: Extending data-driven controller synthesis to new performance objectives
projects.summary: Extend the lab's data-driven controller synthesis framework, which currently handles H2, Hinf and IQC-based robustness specifications, to alternative objectives such as H1 and regret-based criteria. The work includes theory, implementation in the datadriven library, and experimental validation on lab systems with saturation constraints.

projects.title: Meta-learning for neural network control of the Franka robot
projects.summary: Investigate meta-learning methods such as MAML for neural-network controllers in control tasks, integrating control-specific architectures. Performance will be assessed through simulations of the Franka robot.

projects.title: Meta-learning neural controllers for quadcopter disturbance rejection
projects.summary: Use meta-learning (e.g. MAML) to train neural-network controllers that adapt quickly to changing disturbance profiles such as wind. Methods will be implemented in a simulated quadcopter environment and compared with standard training from scratch.

projects.title: Online switching schemes for performance-boosting controllers (wind turbine)
projects.summary: Design new online switching schemes for performance-boosting controllers, inspired by online convex optimization, and prove regret guarantees for them. The schemes will be tested in simulation for wind turbine control. The project is linked to the external DECODE project.

projects.title: Partial feedback linearization for inverted pendulum swing-up
projects.summary: Implement a partial feedback linearization algorithm for swinging up an inverted pendulum, then extend the algorithm to the data-driven setting. The controller will be tested on the hardware setup using LabVIEW.

projects.title: Performance boosting for non-holonomic bumper cars
projects.summary: Improve the performance of three non-holonomic bumper cars in a 7x10 arena so they reach target positions with a prescribed final orientation. The method uses reference Performance Boosting, a learned component added to a base controller on top of a data-driven MLP model of the cars, while preserving stability guarantees.

projects.title: Robust real-time controller for adaptive optics
projects.summary: Design and synthesise a robust real-time controller for an adaptive optics system that corrects atmospheric wavefront distortions in ground-based telescopes. Validation is planned through simulation and on an adaptive optics testbed. The project is run with an external partner at the Department of Astronomy, University of Geneva.

projects.title: Bachelor project : Mini-segway racing
projects.summary: A bachelor project on mini-segway racing, in which a self-balancing mini-segway is used as a platform for control and racing.

projects.title: Bidirectional Flyback converter for high voltage applications
projects.summary: Add bidirectionality to a flyback DC-DC converter that steps low voltages up to kilovolt levels to power a dielectric elastomer actuator, enabling energy recovery from the load. The project covers topology analysis, simulation with parasitic-aware component selection, implementation and validation.

projects.title: Characterization of a miniaturized actuation module used in biomedical applications
projects.summary: Characterise experimentally and model numerically the miniature coreless DC motor and gear train that actuates modules of a reconfigurable diabetic insole. The goal is to identify lumped electro-mechanical parameters, validate an analytical model, estimate energy consumption, and optimise a commercial ripple-counting motor driver firmware.

projects.title: Control of a Soft Biomimetic Fish Robot
projects.summary: Implement a control algorithm to position the caudal fin of a soft robotic fish driven by fiber-reinforced dielectric elastomer actuators with a buckling beam, enabling steering and speed control. The work includes a state-of-the-art review of control for multi-stable systems and integration with the hardware into a working demonstrator.

projects.title: Dielectric Elastomer Actuators characterization
projects.summary: Characterise tubular dielectric elastomer actuators as distributed transmission-line structures by extracting per-unit-length RLCG parameters from impedance measurements. The project also includes building a mechanical setup to map capacitance against controlled deformation, as a step towards self-sensing.

projects.title: Investigation of auxetic meta-structures for intelligent offloading footwear
