projects.summary: Investigate synclastic auxetic meta-structures capable of double Gaussian curvature to redistribute plantar pressure in an intelligent offloading insole. The project covers a Python tool for unit-cell design, experimental validation on a test bench, and fabrication of prototypes.

projects.title: Multilayer Dielectric Elastomer Actuators for Intelligent Pressure Offloading in Diabetic Footwear
projects.summary: Design and fabricate multilayer dielectric elastomer actuators with around 100 layers to provide large displacement and stiffness modulation for plantar pressure offloading. The student will characterise displacement, force, stiffness and reliability, and investigate failure mechanisms.

projects.title: Origami\Kirigami as Negative Biasing Mechanism for Dielectric Elastomer Actuators
projects.summary: Use Kresling origami and kirigami structures as a bistable negative biasing mechanism to provide optimal pre-stretch for stacked dielectric elastomer actuators and achieve high strains. The student will fabricate the structures, integrate them with DEA prototypes and characterise the actuation performance.

projects.title: Self-Clearing Carbon Black Electrodes for Durable Soft Cardiac Actuators
projects.summary: Develop ultra-thin self-clearing carbon black electrodes for dielectric elastomer actuators used in soft heart assist devices. The student will prepare formulations varying carbon black concentration and deposition, and characterise conductivity, adhesion, stretchability, cyclic stability and self-clearing behaviour.

projects.title: Self-sensing for artificial muscles
projects.summary: Investigate using dielectric elastomer actuators as self-sensing elements by exploiting their deformation-dependent capacitance, including parallel configurations to increase sensitivity. The student will fabricate prototypes and correlate electrical measurements with mechanical deformation for real-time monitoring.

projects.title: Smart Actuators: Exploring Ultrasonic Vibration Sources
projects.summary: Explore, design and evaluate compact actuators based on piezoelectric and magnetostrictive smart materials to generate high-frequency vibrations for the core actuation unit of a dental medical device. The project includes building a proof-of-concept prototype and experimentally characterising its frequency, amplitude and temperature variation, in collaboration with an industry partner.

projects.title: Soft Fluidic Memory Sensor for Intelligent Offloading Footwear
projects.summary: Perform a first experimental validation of a soft fluidic sensing element based on a flexible polymer structure with conductive fluid, whose impedance changes under compression. The project tests fabrication, compares design variations and evaluates signal amplitude, repeatability, drift and transient response.

projects.title: Bearings
projects.summary: A master or semester project on bearings, a core machine element in mechanical design.

projects.title: Design
projects.summary: A master or semester project in mechanical design at the Laboratory for Applied Mechanical Design.

projects.title: Turbomachinery
projects.summary: A master or semester project on turbomachinery, the design and analysis of machines that exchange energy with a fluid.

projects.title: Control Plane Design for Optical Switch
projects.summary: Develop the control plane software that manages the state of an optical switch, translating high-level network requests into commands for the optical engine and reporting telemetry to a central SDN controller. The student will build a switch management daemon and an abstraction of optical components as logical network resources.

projects.title: Design and Application of Organ-on-chip Platforms via Tomographic Printing
projects.summary: Use tomographic volumetric additive manufacturing to directly print high-complexity, perfusable models inside preassembled, leak-proof TVAM-compatible chips with integrated fluidics. The goal is to create organ-on-chip platforms for drug discovery and safety testing.

projects.title: Engineering strategies to perfuse bioprinted 3D models of pancreatic cancer
projects.summary: Develop strategies to perfuse bioprinted 3D models of pancreatic tissue in order to study the molecular interactions between pancreatic cancer cells and stromal cells. The models aim to better understand the stiffening tumor microenvironment.

projects.title: Optimization of Fiber Probes and Imaging Conditions for Biological Samples
projects.summary: Optimize the FLIMME fluorescence lifetime endomicroscope, which combines wavefront shaping through a single multimode fiber with frequency-domain FLIM, for imaging organoids, transwell cultures and excised tissue. The goal is to adapt the probe and imaging conditions to these biological samples.

projects.title: Opto-Mechanical Design of Optical Switches for AI
projects.summary: Design the mechanical architecture of a compact multi-layer optical switching unit housing optical engines, mirrors, SLMs and fibers while keeping micron-level alignment stable under thermal load. The work includes CAD design, thermal and vibration analysis, and prototyping of the unit.

projects.title: Printing in situ using an ultra-thin MMF probe
projects.summary: Develop and characterize an ultra-thin multimode fiber probe for in-situ 3D printing by photopolymerization, using wavefront shaping on the FLIMME setup. The work covers improving the trapped-air probe design, measuring the printing dose response, and building Python-based pattern generation for complex structures.

projects.title: Two-photon endoscopic imaging using a multi-mode fiber
projects.summary: Develop two-photon fluorescence endoscopic imaging through a multi-mode fiber using an ultrashort pulsed laser. The work must address pulse broadening from group velocity dispersion in the fiber to enable nonlinear imaging.

projects.title: Uncovering and Solving O2-Gradient Induced Artifacts in TVAM
projects.summary: Systematically test the achievable resolution of tomographic volumetric additive manufacturing (TVAM) prints under various resins, vial geometries and illumination settings. The project combines a diffusion-aware optimization model, the open-source Dr.TVAM framework, simulations and experimental validation to map resolution limits.

projects.title: A Modular Simulation and Analysis Platform for Multi-Limb Coordination
projects.summary: Build a lightweight, modular Python platform that combines motion data processing with simulation-based evaluation of existing dynamical system controllers. The student does not design new control or learning algorithms; the focus is on infrastructure for testing, visualizing and comparing models in multi-limb scenarios.

projects.title: Defying Newton's third law: designing a vibrotactile stimulator without recoil
projects.summary: Design and prototype a handheld, wireless vibrotactile stimulator that delivers precise vibrations for self-testing of touch sensitivity, paired with a smartphone app. The central challenge is making the tip vibrate without transmitting off-target vibration and acoustic noise to the handle.

projects.title: Force-Aware Sequential Multi-Object Grasping with Coupled Contact
projects.summary: Grasp multiple objects in sequence while taking contact forces into account.

projects.title: Human-Robot Collaborative Manipulation
projects.summary: Develop manipulation tasks in which a robot and a human collaborate on the same object.

projects.title: Multi-Arm Manipulation of Deformable Objects in Contact-Rich Environments
projects.summary: Coordinate multiple robotic arms to manipulate deformable objects in environments with many contacts.

projects.title: Objective Evaluation of Surgical Skills Training Tools
projects.summary: Build objective methods to evaluate the effectiveness of tools used to train surgical skills.

projects.title: Open Source Cloud Robotic Manipulation
projects.summary: Build an open-source cloud-based system for robotic manipulation.

projects.title: Quantitative Assessment of Microsurgical Skills
projects.summary: Quantitatively assess microsurgical skills from measured data.

projects.title: Robust Stable Manipulation with Dexterous Hands under Changing External Forces
projects.summary: Extends a previous bimanual gripper planning approach to multi-finger dexterous hands, aiming to keep manipulation stable under time-varying external wrenches. The work combines an online stability margin estimator, a constrained controller respecting contact, friction and actuation limits, and optimization-based strategy reconfiguration with minimal switching.

projects.title: Soft Tactile Sensor Simulation & Sim-to-Real Engineering
projects.summary: Develop simulation models of soft tactile sensors and transfer them to real hardware (sim-to-real).

projects.title: Surgical Robotics Competitivity Report
projects.summary: Produce a report analysing the competitive landscape of surgical robotics.

projects.title: DNA chips for SICS
Engineering nanofluidic memories for brain-inspired ionic processes
Hybrid nanopores for SICS
Master project proposal: AFM
Master project proposal: single molecule
Multiplexing and benchmarking for SICS
Nanocapillary fabrication for SICS
Car-T cell engineering
projects.summary: Develop novel chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) with enhanced efficacy against solid tumors. The student generates mouse CAR-T cells, working on molecular cloning, T-cell biology, cell culture and flow cytometry.

projects.title: Chemical immunoengineering
projects.summary: Development of assays to study how immune cells interact with cancer cells under the influence of smart prodrugs and biomaterials. Students learn mammalian cell culture, lymphocyte and cancer cell isolation, culture assays, sample preparation, labeling and data analysis.

projects.title: Mechanical immunoengineering
projects.summary: Use biophysical cues to enhance the proliferation of T cells for cell-based therapies, since current activation and expansion protocols are sub-optimal. The student works on activation of mouse primary T cells.

projects.title: Scaffolding for immune cell activation and expansion
projects.summary: Develop a hydrogel-based 3D cell scaffold that supports the survival, growth, expansion and function of immune cells. The work examines how to control and modify the hydrogel's physicochemical properties and then studies activation, expansion and phenotypes of T cells and NK cells in the scaffold.

projects.title: Master thesis position: High-throughput in vitro screening of hybridoma libraries for the identification of HER2-targeting agonistic antibodies
projects.summary: Screen the lab's existing hybridoma libraries in vitro to find antibodies that bind HER2+ breast cancer cells, then test binders in functional cell-based assays to identify at least one validated agonistic antibody to serve as a positive control. The work combines flow cytometry and ELISA with receptor activation and signaling assays.

projects.title: Master thesis position: Integration of a signature matching algorithm into a scRNAseq bioinformatic pipeline for agonistic antibody discovery
projects.summary: Integrate a newly developed signature matching package into the lab's R-based scRNAseq pipeline so that individual cell profiles are matched directly to pathways in public databases, without prior clustering. The project includes code refactoring, computational optimisation, and benchmarking against clustering-based methods for identifying agonistic antibodies.

projects.title: Microfluidics-guided personalized cancer immunotherapy
projects.summary: Establish light-sheet imaging-based fluorescence assays on microfluidic tumor biopsy platforms to measure killing of cancer cells by T-cells, with the goal of predicting outcomes of immune therapies. The work includes optimising fluorescent antibody staining of different cell types.

projects.title: AFM image processing plugin for converting high-speed AFM data to video (Gwyddion)
projects.summary: Design and test a Gwyddion plugin that automatically processes series of high-speed AFM images from the same experiment and converts them into video format. The goal is to replace slow one-by-one image processing.

projects.title: Contact Resonance Measurements with AFM in vacuum
projects.summary: Enable contact resonance AFM (CR-AFM) measurements inside the SEM chamber by sending a signal to the sample and tracking the contact resonance frequency with a lock-in amplifier. The aim is to map sample mechanical properties and complement SEM chemical contrast.

projects.title: Integration of sharp tips for high resolution AFM imaging
projects.summary: Develop a microfabrication process that adds sharp silicon tips to AFM cantilevers directly during fabrication, instead of adding them manually one by one. This is a proof-of-concept fabrication project for self-sensing cantilevers.

projects.title: Integration of shielded tip-connection for electrical AFM measurements
projects.summary: Modify the cantilever process flow to add a grounded metal connection between the two signal lines, reducing cross-talk between embedded electronics and the tip connection. The goal is to use the fabricated cantilevers for electrical AFM measurements such as piezoresponse force microscopy.

projects.title: Optimisation of cantilever sensors to increase signal-to-noise ratio
projects.summary: Replace the current polysilicon piezoresistive sensing element of the cantilevers with single crystal silicon, which has a much higher gauge factor, to improve the signal-to-noise ratio. This requires modifying the current process flow.

projects.title: Interfacial Imaging of Membrane Water
projects.summary: PhD project developing second harmonic water imaging to image interfacial water and electrostatic field lines on lipid membrane models, and to image membrane fusion and osmosis in real time, linking molecular information to membrane electrostatics and mechanics.

projects.title: Long- and short- range structure in electrolyte solutions
projects.summary: PhD project using home-built nonlinear optical scattering and imaging methods (second harmonic imaging, angle-resolved second harmonic scattering, correlated vibrational spectroscopy) to study the multi-scale structure of concentrated electrolyte solutions in water and at aqueous interfaces.

projects.title: Machine Learning for the Parametric Optimization of Metasurface Photonic Devices
projects.summary: The student develops a physics-informed machine learning model to find the metasurface parameters that achieve target optical responses, such as vortex light, asymmetric angular scattering or pseudochiral effects. The work also covers inverse design of scattering particles by interfacing Python or MATLAB with COMSOL, with electromagnetic simulation and optimization of metasurfaces based on the GSTC framework.

projects.title: Model reduction for bouncing drops
projects.summary: The project develops a reduced-order model of drops bouncing on a surface.

projects.title: Tears of rain – fingering instability without a contact line
projects.summary: The project investigates the fingering instability of a liquid film that forms on a surface without a contact line, inspired by tears of rain.

projects.title: Wave interactions in Faraday instability
projects.summary: The project studies how waves interact in the Faraday instability, a pattern-forming instability of fluid surfaces under vertical vibration.

projects.title: Analysis of dendritic spine changes using deep-learning encoding in a latent space
projects.summary: The project aims to build a deep learning system that reconstructs the temporal evolution of dendritic spine shapes from 3D time-lapse microscopy data. Spine shapes will be encoded into a low-dimensional latent space to identify trajectories that classify single-spine behaviour.

projects.title: Automated image analysis of tau fibrils in the human Alzheimer's disease brain
projects.summary: Develop a Python image analysis workflow to detect and segment tau fibrils in human Alzheimer's disease brain tissue imaged with correlative light and electron microscopy. The goal is to measure fibril twist and relate it to the stage and clustering of tau tangles.

projects.title: Continuous-Domain Phase Retrieval in Dimension One
projects.summary: Develop and benchmark a coarse-to-fine (multiscale) numerical solver for recovering a complex-valued continuous-domain signal from magnitude-only linear measurements. The solver runs Wirtinger Flow at a coarse scale and propagates estimates up the resolution hierarchy as warm starts, and is compared with single-scale Wirtinger Flow with spectral initialization at full resolution.

projects.title: Exploring Global Youth Art Through AI: A Semantic Analysis of the IMAJ Collection
projects.summary: Semantic analysis of a collection of more than 100,000 drawings by young artists aged 3 to 25 from 150 countries, using large language models adapted to the artistic and cultural context. The work starts by evaluating models on curated subsets, then scales up to generate textual interpretations that enrich the database with metadata.

projects.title: High-Dimensional Gaussian Sampling: Cholesky versus Markov
projects.summary: Compares three approaches to sampling high-dimensional Gaussians: exact Cholesky-factorization-based linear algebra, iterative Markov Chain Monte Carlo methods, and Perturb-and-Map. The goal is to determine the best trade-off between computational speed and statistical accuracy for large-scale inverse problems.

projects.title: Sampling from Learned Regularizers
projects.summary: Investigates posterior sampling for linear inverse problems using energy-based priors built from learnable potential functions applied to linear filter responses. The goal is to implement and analyze sampling algorithms such as the (annealed) Metropolis adjusted Langevin algorithm on these models for Bayesian uncertainty quantification.

projects.title: Training Complex-Valued Denoisers for Phase Retrieval
projects.summary: Train a denoiser that operates directly on complex-valued data to regularize magnitude and phase jointly in phase retrieval. The work compares Plug-and-Play, diffusion and flow-matching paradigms and benchmarks the joint complex denoiser against magnitude/phase splitting.

projects.title: A Cross-Cultural Study of Podcasts for Well-Being Information Dissemination
projects.summary: Examines how health and well-being topics are framed in podcasts across cultural and language contexts, combining NLP analysis of podcast metadata and transcripts with grounded theory, and relating framing choices to audience engagement.

projects.title: Adapting foundation models for knowledge transfer in out-of-distribution medical data
projects.summary: Develops adaptive fine-tuning methods for foundation models that reduce performance disparities under distribution shift in medical data, along with benchmarks and evaluation protocols for drift detection and equity-performance trade-offs.

projects.title: Advancing CT-Based Characterization of Poorly Understood Vascular Diseases Through Foundation Models
projects.summary: Aims to develop an interpretable computer-aided diagnostic tool for fibromuscular dysplasia in renal arteries from CTA scans, using segmentation of renal arteries and classification of lesions with machine learning, in collaboration with Idiap and CHUV.

projects.title: Agentic retrieval augmented generation interface for sleep Medicine
projects.summary: Focuses on building a Scientific Literature Agent using retrieval-augmented generation over sleep scoring guidelines and medical literature, integrating it with a central LLM and a GUI demonstrator for clinicians (OmniSleep project).

projects.title: An open-source framework for the quantification of Urban Heat Islands in Switzerland
projects.summary: Aims to build an open-source Python or C++ framework that converts Swiss open datasets into inputs for CitySim and ENVI-met, introduces Physiological Equivalent Temperature in CitySim, and quantifies urban heat mitigation scenarios on two Swiss case studies.

projects.title: Assessing Lyrics-Based Item Profiles for Music Information Retrieval
projects.summary: Studies whether text-based item profiles built from lyrics and lyric-related resources give more task-relevant representations than direct lyric embeddings for MIR tasks such as genre classification, mood or tag prediction, and retrieval.

projects.title: Audiovisual person recognition
projects.summary: Aims to combine audio and visual biometric person identification systems, either by developing them separately and fusing their outputs or by building a single system taking both embeddings as input, building on Idiap's NIST SRE 2019 scripts.

projects.title: Automatic identification of flight information from speech
projects.summary: Aims to develop a unified model, for example adapting BERT, that maps speech directly to aviation call-signs, and compare it with independently trained speech recognition and concept-extraction modules.

projects.title: Automatic named entity recognition from speech
projects.summary: Aims to improve recognition of named entities directly from speech by training the speech recognition and named entity recognition modules together end-to-end, and comparing this with independently trained modules.

projects.title: Automatic speech recognition of air-traffic communication using grammar
projects.summary: Aims to build a baseline ASR system for air-traffic controllers in Kaldi and to explore context-free grammar language modeling based on ICAO phraseology, either replacing or enriching statistical language models.

projects.title: Cognitive architecture for assistive robots
projects.summary: Aims to integrate the Lio robot with the DIARC cognitive architecture from Tufts HRILab, connecting it to ROS and developing human-robot interaction demos.

projects.title: Design of robotic teleoperation interface
projects.summary: Aims to design a web-based teleoperation interface for the Lio robot, covering navigation, manipulation, and speech, to support public demonstrations and assistive-robotics design studies with caregivers and users.

projects.title: Dynamic Frequency Allocation for Speech Separation
projects.summary: Investigates whether speech separation models such as TIGER should allocate frequency resolution dynamically per input mixture while keeping computational cost fixed. Includes analysis of per-utterance performance across fixed frequency partitions and a possible lightweight predictor of frequency allocation, with attention to pathological speech.

projects.title: Efficient Robot Data Collection through Geometric Shared Autonomy
projects.summary: Extends the GeoSACS interface, which represents task structure with a canal surface and lets users correct trajectories with a low-dimensional joystick, into a synchronized multimodal data-recording pipeline for robot manipulation. The project compares its data collection efficiency with conventional teleoperation and prepares datasets for imitation learning.

projects.title: Error correction in speech recognition using large pre-trained language models
projects.summary: Investigates whether large pre-trained language models can correct errors in speech transcription output, analysing error types and comparing traditional and conversational language models, including rescoring of N-best hypotheses.

projects.title: Faithful Vision-Language Explanations for Unified Face Attack Detection
projects.summary: Aims to build a face attack (presentation attack and deepfake) detector paired with a vision-language model that produces explanations, plus a verifier that tests whether generated claims are faithful by perturbing the claimed evidence. The work targets cross-dataset and unseen attack evaluation.

projects.title: From Audiobooks to Character Utterances: Automatic Annotation of Speakers in Literary Fiction
projects.summary: Aims to build a pipeline that automatically annotates speech utterances from LibriVox dramatic-reading audiobooks with their speaking character, to create a large annotated dataset for quotation attribution in fiction.

projects.title: From Gaze Following to Joint Attention
projects.summary: Trains and evaluates a transformer-based gaze following model on a new dataset, measuring gaze following and joint attention, then extends the architecture to predict joint attention end-to-end, in collaboration with the University of Zurich.

projects.title: From Personal Stories to Collective Narratives: Computational Analysis of Health Narratives in Podcasts
projects.summary: Aims to develop a computational framework that automatically identifies personal health narratives in podcast transcripts and clusters them to reveal recurring narrative themes.

projects.title: From Scientific Data to Citizen Communication: Weather Nowcasting in Malabo, Equatorial Guinea
projects.summary: Aims to build an end-to-end machine-learning pipeline for short-term torrential rain nowcasting in Malabo using open data, integrating a local weather station, and a basic text-based alert system tested in a real scenario, in collaboration with local partners.

projects.title: Gaze-Guided Shared Autonomy for Object Manipulation
projects.summary: Aims to add eye gaze as a source of user intent to a joystick-based shared autonomy framework for object manipulation, fusing gaze with joystick input to predict intent earlier and more accurately, especially in cluttered scenes.

projects.title: Multimodal Learning for Automated Grading of Retinal Inflammation in Dynamic Imaging
projects.summary: Aims to design and validate multimodal machine learning models that automatically detect and grade retinal inflammation from fluorescein angiography images and videos, and to identify interpretable imaging biomarkers.

projects.title: Parametric Gaze Following
projects.summary: Explores casting gaze following as prediction of a parametric probability distribution (e.g. mixture of Gaussians) instead of a heatmap, and proposes new metrics that capture more information about the predicted distribution.

projects.title: Pathological speech detection in adverse environments
projects.summary: Examines how state-of-the-art automatic speech processing approaches for diagnosing motor speech disorders perform under noise and reverberation typical of clinical recordings, and develops targeted approaches if relevant.

projects.title: Pathological speech enhancement
projects.summary: Examines the performance of state-of-the-art speech enhancement approaches on pathological speech (e.g. hearing loss, head and neck cancers, neurological disorders), and develops approaches targeting pathological speech if time permits.

projects.title: Person Head Detection
projects.summary: Aims to compile public head-annotated datasets and train and evaluate an object detector that localizes whole human heads, with data augmentation for extreme head poses, packaged as a reusable inference pipeline for gaze tracking and head pose estimation.

projects.title: Pseudo labeling of Sensitive Attributes in Medical Imaging for Demographically Fair Machine Learning
projects.summary: Develops machine learning models that pseudo-label sensitive attributes such as gender or age in medical imaging datasets lacking such annotations, and assesses the impact of these pseudo-labels on fairness and performance.

projects.title: Punctuation restoration on automatic speech recognition output
projects.summary: Aims to train a model that adds punctuation, and optionally capitalization, to ASR output to improve readability and usefulness for downstream tasks, evaluated on several languages and real scenarios.

projects.title: Research Spotlight: Crafting An Interactive Webpage Template for Showcasing Science
projects.summary: Aims to create a versatile, feature-rich webpage template for showcasing research papers, including interactive elements for model demonstrations, and to evaluate tools such as Streamlit and Gradio for this purpose.

projects.title: Robotics: Automated discovery of material properties using dextrous manipulation, vision tools, and learning agents.
projects.summary: Aims to develop a classification framework for solid and semi-solid materials in automated sampling workflows using the FR3 and UR3e robots, vision, and force-torque or rheological cues to identify properties such as viscosity, adhesiveness, cohesiveness and granularity.

projects.title: Scaling Pre-training for Gaze Following
projects.summary: Aims to pre-train gaze following models on large curated video datasets using pseudo-annotations from strong gaze following models, then fine-tune and evaluate them on annotated video datasets.

projects.title: Social media and crowdsourcing for social good
projects.summary: Offers several student projects within a multidisciplinary initiative on social media analytics, visualization of social and crowdsourced data, and smartphone apps for mobile crowdsourcing, with collaborators in Europe and the Majority World.

projects.title: Spatio-temporal Modeling of Human Behavior in Videos
projects.summary: Explores spatio-temporal video encoders trained end-to-end to extract features for facial behavior tasks such as head gesture and facial expression recognition, with possible weakly-supervised joint learning from pseudo-annotations.

projects.title: Speaker identification enhanced by the social network analyser
projects.summary: Aims to build a speaker identification baseline and a graph/network analysis tool, then combine speech and network information to improve person identification on simulated lawful-investigation data, using open-source tools such as SpeechBrain and SocNetV.

projects.title: Speech/Music Classification
projects.summary: Aims to develop a classifier that discriminates speech from music and possibly noise, starting from an evaluation of existing speech/music and voice activity detection approaches on established data.

projects.title: Towards Scalable and Interpretable Foundation Models for physiologicals signals recorded during human sleep
projects.summary: Aims to develop self-supervised pretraining strategies for polysomnographic and EEG signals, then fine-tune and evaluate the encoders on sleep staging and seizure detection, including cross-dataset generalization.

projects.title: Understanding generalization in deep learning
projects.summary: Studies how the inductive biases of architectures and data properties explain generalization in deep learning, through experiments with various architectures and datasets, with theoretical or practical emphasis depending on the student.

projects.title: Understanding the robustness of machine learning models on underspecified tasks
projects.summary: Studies how in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance of deep learning models evolves during pre-training and fine-tuning, aiming to develop model selection strategies for robust models and produce results suitable for a scientific publication.

projects.title: Using large pretrained language models in speech recognition
projects.summary: Measures how large pretrained language models perform in ASR by scoring the outputs of a speech recognition model and combining the scores to refine transcriptions, comparing model sizes and families and the value of retraining the language model.

projects.title: Whole-Body Manipulation with Explicit Self-Balancing Control for Humanoid Robots
projects.summary: Aims to develop a whole-body control strategy for a humanoid robot (Unitree G1) that jointly treats balance and manipulation, accounting for the mass and inertia of arms and manipulated objects. Part of the work may be carried out on-site at S3C in Biel.

projects.title: Applications of Spectral/Conditional-Gradient Optimizers in FL, RL, and Reasoning
projects.summary: MS project exploring where spectral and conditional-gradient optimizers (SCION/MuON-style) bring benefits beyond supervised training, namely federated learning, reinforcement learning and LLM-based reasoning. Students benchmark these optimizers against conventional baselines in those settings.

projects.title: Emerging Optimizers for Large-Batch Training (SCION, MuON, Spectral Methods)
projects.summary: MS project investigating geometry-aware optimizers such as SCION, MuON, Stochastic Spectral Descent and Frank-Wolfe-based variants for stable large-batch training of deep networks. Students characterize their memory footprint, preconditioning, critical batch size and stability versus Adam/Lion/Shampoo, and evaluate them on large-batch pipelines (transformers, MoE).

projects.title: Online Adaptation and Dynamic Geometry in Modern Optimizers
projects.summary: MS project on online adaptation mechanisms for geometry-aware optimizers, such as dynamically adjusting preconditioners, spectral norms, constraint radii, learning rates and FW-LMO approximations during training. The goal is to design low-memory algorithms that adapt to curvature and distribution drift, tested on large-scale training setups.

projects.title: Rethinking Diffusion Modeling from the Ground Up: Building a Diffusion-LLM
projects.summary: Project rethinking diffusion modeling from first principles to build a diffusion-based LLM as part of the Swiss AI Initiative. Students explore new discrete/structured diffusion formulations, prototype diffusion-LLM architectures, and compare them with autoregressive transformers, with a theoretical direction (combinatorial optimization and submodularity) and a large-scale implementation direction.

projects.title: Risk-Aware Selective Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Language Modeling
projects.summary: The project extends the risk-aware selective language modeling framework (ESLM) to Mixture-of-Experts architectures by designing a risk-aware routing mechanism that routes inputs to experts based on confidence and risk estimates. The goal is more efficient training and inference with robustness to distribution shifts and adversarial inputs, evaluated against standard MoE routing strategies.

projects.title: Characterization of TiN layers deposited with Plasma Enhanced Atomic Layer Deposition (PEALD) for 3D Superconducting nanostructures
projects.summary: Characterize titanium nitride (TiN) layers deposited by plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD), for use in 3D superconducting nanostructures.

projects.title: Fabrication and characterization of ferromagnetic Josephson junctions for superspintronics
projects.summary: Fabricate and characterize ferromagnetic Josephson junctions for superspintronics, combining superconducting and spintronic functionality.

projects.title: Investigation of vortex dynamics in 3D superconducting nano-structures using Time-Dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory with COMSOL Multiphysics
projects.summary: Study vortex dynamics in 3D superconducting nanostructures by simulation with Time-Dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory in COMSOL Multiphysics.

projects.title: Spectroscopy on spin waves in ferromagnet/ferrimagnet hybrid nanostructures
projects.summary: Perform spectroscopy measurements of spin waves in hybrid nanostructures combining a ferromagnet and a ferrimagnet.

projects.title: Amplification of greyscale nanopatterning via thermal scanning probe lithography and dry etching techniques
projects.summary: The project aims to combine thermal scanning probe lithography (t-SPL) with plasma dry etching to amplify nanoscale resist topographies into dielectric substrates while keeping pattern fidelity and reproducibility. Surface topography will be characterised by AFM and SEM to assess pattern transfer and amplification.

projects.title: Characterization of Ultrasound-Activated Piezoelectric Microbeads for Bioelectronic Applications
projects.summary: Experimental characterization of the piezoelectric response of ultrasound-activated composite microbeads (BaTiO₃ and Fe₃O₄ particles) made by microfluidics, to quantify how they convert ultrasound into electrical signals for wireless neural stimulation and minimally invasive biomedical devices.

projects.title: Designing MR Guidance for Microfabrication via Real-World Interaction
projects.summary: Develop and evaluate a mixed reality system for microfabrication learning, using Unity 3D and HoloLens, with real-world object interaction, sensor data via Azure IoT Hub, and a small usability study to drive iterative design.

projects.title: Microchannel characterization of liquid sample for Dynamic Nuclear Polarization (DNP) measurements
projects.summary: Develop and validate methods for filling, sealing, and characterizing microchannels for liquid samples on an in-house miniaturized DNP chip. If needed, the project also explores a new microchannel device concept, possibly involving clean-room fabrication.

projects.title: Optimization of Ion Beam Etching for IGZO Thin-Film Transistors on Biodegradable Substrates
projects.summary: The project aims to optimize ion beam etching parameters for IGZO films patterned by stencil lithography, targeting the steepest possible edge with a controllable etching rate. It may extend to biodegradable substrates and to closed-loop IGZO structures made with bridge stencils.

projects.title: Parametric study of induction sintering iron
projects.summary: Study of induction sintering of iron, an advanced powder metallurgy technique in which electromagnetic induction heats conductive material directly. The induced eddy currents heat the material by Joule effect and hysteresis and help break down oxide barriers between particles through local discharges. The project is a parametric study of this process.

projects.title: Laser Powder Bed Fusion manufacturing of ferromagnetic materials
projects.summary: Master (PDM) project on laser powder bed fusion manufacturing of ferromagnetic materials, carried out in collaboration with CSEM in Neuchâtel.

projects.title: Master project in industry: Titanium alloy product forming
projects.summary: Master project in an industrial setting on forming products made from titanium alloys.

projects.title: Master thesis project Fall 2025: Study of the microstructure-properties relationship of a precious metal alloy dedicated to additive manufacturing
projects.summary: Studies how the microstructure of a precious metal alloy relates to its properties, with the alloy intended for additive manufacturing.

projects.title: Automated Winding Machine for Meter-long Fiber Motors
projects.summary: Design, build and test an improved winding machine able to produce fiber motors up to 5 m long, compared with the current 50 cm. The project also includes characterizing fiber quality such as pitch uniformity, electrode continuity and insulation integrity.

projects.title: Decoding the Propagation of Tactile Waves
projects.summary: Study how elastic waves generated by touch propagate through skin by mapping them in vivo with skin-conformal wearable haptic devices. The work also includes multilayer skin phantoms and a finite element model with a fast surrogate model validated against experiments.

projects.title: Development of a mechanical fluidic guide wire for intravascular procedures
projects.summary: Develop a manually operated, fluidically untethered, steerable guide wire for vascular intervention, in parallel with an electrofluidic version. The project includes interfacing with clinical collaborators to turn their feedback into product development benchmarks.

projects.title: Eco-friendly Degradable and Recyclable Wireless RFID Sensing Tags for Logistics
projects.summary: Develop biodegradable RFID and NFC sensing tags printed on paper substrates for item identification and monitoring of perishable goods. Master projects focus on temperature threshold sensors, tag design and fabrication, and biodegradation; semester projects cover one or more of these aspects.

projects.title: Eco-friendly Disposable Wireless Biochemical Sensor for Point of Care Diagnostics
projects.summary: Design, fabricate and characterize biodegradable zinc-based wireless LC sensing labels with microfluidic channels for detecting ionic solutions. As a master project, the platform can be biofunctionalized to detect specific analytes in body fluids such as sweat.

projects.title: Embedding Sensors into Microfluidics using Vat photopolymerization (VPP) 3D printing
projects.summary: Fabricate electrodes and embed them as sensors into 3D-printed microfluidic channels using a print-pause-print process, then characterize and biofunctionalize them for saliva biomarker analysis in a smart denture.

projects.title: FiberMotor at company Elecsyor
projects.summary: Develop advanced manufacturing methods and automated test benches for a flexible fiber-format electrostatic linear motor, working with the start-up Elecyor near Lyon, France. The project is a master project carried out in a company.

projects.title: Numerical simulation and optimization of electrohydrodynamic pumps
projects.summary: Continue developing a COMSOL Multiphysics numerical model of electrohydrodynamic (EHD) pumps, validate it against experimental data, and then pursue topological optimization of the pump. Optimized designs may be prototyped and tested on a high-voltage bench.

projects.title: Time temperature indicator microfluidic module with integrated capacitive sensor
projects.summary: Design, fabricate and characterize a battery-free microfluidic module with embedded phase-change material and a capacitive transducer, for cold-chain temperature monitoring. The goal is to discriminate between a few and several hours spent above 8°C.

projects.title: Transient Electrode Biointerfaces: Functionalization of Zn/Carbon for Multi-Analyte Recognition
projects.summary: Develop biodegradable biointerfaces on zinc and carbon electrodes that can be functionalized with receptors for a range of analytes while preserving transience. Work includes surface analysis and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, with optional sensing and stability tests.

projects.title: Zinc Electroplating on Laser Induced Graphene for Transient Eco-Friendly Electronics
projects.summary: Develop transient zinc metallization by electroplating zinc onto laser-induced graphene patterned on biodegradable substrates such as wood or paper. The work covers process optimization, device demonstrators, and, for master projects, reliability and end-of-life studies.

projects.title: Dissolved Gas Separation From Liquid Electrolyte For Membrane Less Electrolyzers
projects.summary: Separate dissolved gas from the liquid electrolyte of membrane-less electrolyzers.

projects.title: Effect Of Different Catalysts On The Performance Of Membrane Less Water Electrolyzers
projects.summary: Investigate how different catalysts affect the performance of membrane-less water electrolyzers.

projects.title: Energy Storage In The Form Of Hydrogen Using Membrane Less Electrolyzers
projects.summary: Study the use of membrane-less electrolyzers to store energy as hydrogen.

projects.title: Membrane Less Electrolyser Stack Characterization
projects.summary: Characterize the performance of a membrane-less electrolyser stack.

projects.title: Multimode Fiber Based High Speed Optical Computing Modelling and Control with Neural Networks
projects.summary: Model and control a high-speed optical computing system based on multimode fibers, using neural networks.

projects.title: Multimode Fiber Based Optical Computing Unit for Large Scale Neural Networks
projects.summary: Develop an optical computing unit based on multimode fibers for large-scale neural networks.

projects.title: Assessment of the residual stresses of composites produced by frontal polymerisation
projects.summary: The project aims to assess residual stresses in carbon fibre reinforced polymer composites produced by frontal polymerisation, comparing them with oven-cured composites. The student will manufacture laminates, measure strains via warpage or slitting techniques, and back-calculate the stresses.

projects.title: Characterization and optimization of a UV cured composite coating for biodegradable substrates
projects.summary: Characterization and optimization of a UV-cured composite coating applied to biodegradable substrates.

projects.title: Closed-Loop Recycling of Photocured Glass-Fiber Reinforced Composites Based on Transesterification
projects.summary: Develop a dual-cure vitrimer resin based on Aza-Michael addition followed by UV photopolymerization, with transesterification chemistry enabling recyclability. The student will manufacture glass-fiber composites by vacuum infusion, test their thermo-mechanical and vitrimeric properties, and assess closed-loop depolymerization and reuse of recovered fibers and resin.

projects.title: Design of a Heated Mold System to Study Flow-Front Dynamics in Liquid Composite Molding
projects.summary: Design of a heated mold system for studying flow-front dynamics in liquid composite molding.

projects.title: Design Optimisation and Experimental Testing of Composite T-joints
projects.summary: The thesis develops a parametric finite-element optimisation pipeline for T-joint geometries representative of composite blade-to-disk interfaces in high-speed thermoplastic impellers. The student will also test existing T-joint specimens under quasi-static loading with full-field DIC, and possibly fabricate and test optimised geometries.

projects.title: Dynamic wetting measurement with image analysis on synchrotron x-ray tomography data
projects.summary: The project evaluates whether wetting dynamics can be studied from 4D synchrotron X-ray CT images of fabric impregnation. It involves segmenting large 3D+t datasets into fibers, liquid, air and other phases, then modelling the dynamic contact angle as a function of contact-line velocity.

projects.title: Effect of Aligned and Offset fiber Placement on Flow behavior and Permeability
projects.summary: Study of how aligned and offset fiber placement affects flow behavior and permeability.

projects.title: Effect of temperature on fluid properties and flow patterns in LCM
projects.summary: Investigate how elevated temperature affects flow-front dynamics and impregnation patterns in fibrous preforms during liquid composite molding, using a heated mold and a PEG / zinc iodide model liquid. The project characterises the temperature-dependent surface tension, viscosity, density, thermal conductivity and specific heat of the model liquid.

projects.title: Life Cycle Assessment and Circularity Strategy for On-Campus 3D Printing Waste Recycling
projects.summary: Perform a Life Cycle Assessment of ReSpool's PETG filament recycling system and use the results to develop a long-term circularity strategy. The work covers material flows from waste collection to new filament production and compares centralized and decentralized recycling scenarios, including transportation, energy and geographic expansion.

projects.title: Monte Carlo modelling of NetZero scenarios for the carbon fiber industry – dynamic mass and CAPEX flows
projects.summary: Extend an existing Python–Excel Monte Carlo model of the carbon fiber market to 2050 by generating dynamic mass flow analyses by market sector, tracking virgin and reused carbon fiber grades. The project also models the CAPEX flows needed to re-route mass flows in the economy, and includes sensitivity and statistical analyses of key variables.

projects.title: NetPositive modelling of an automotive front seat in SimaPro (life cycle analysis) with shadow pricing
projects.summary: Develop a case study applying the NetPositive methodology to an automotive front seat structure, comparing a steel incumbent with a lightweight polyamide alternative. The work combines SimaPro/ecoinvent life cycle assessment across scope 1, 2 and 3 with shadow-priced externalities and Excel-based NetPositive calculations, including sensitivity analyses of decarbonisation and circular end-of-life levers.

projects.title: Optical detection of matrix cracking in glass-fibre composites using fluorescent mechanophores
projects.summary: The student prepares epoxy formulations containing force-responsive mechanophores as the matrix of glass-fibre composites. The goal is to check whether matrix microcracks can be reported by a local fluorescence response, using optical and fluorescence microscopy on mechanically tested samples.

projects.title: Optimization of a carbon fiber pyrolysis recycling chain
projects.summary: The project aims to validate a process window for recovering carbon fibers from aerospace composite waste by pyrolysis and oxidation, for reuse in second-life applications. It compares lab-scale (OST) and industrial-scale (Composites Recycling S.A.) trials, characterises recovered fibers against virgin carbon fiber, and builds a techno-economic and environmental (SimaPro life-cycle) decision framework.

projects.title: Upcycling discarded glass fiber waste into short fiber reinforced thermoplastic composites
projects.summary: Develop an industrial pathway to reintegrate short recycled glass fibers as reinforcement in thermoplastic composites, combining surface restoration, morphology control and compounding validation. The student compares processability and mechanical performance of virgin versus recycled fibers in short fiber reinforced composites (SFRC), using twin-screw compounding, compression molding, optical analysis and mechanical characterization.

projects.title: Upcycling of recycled carbon fibers for the new generation FRP composites
projects.summary: Design sizing coatings for thermally recycled carbon fibers, targeted at epoxy and Elium matrices, to restore surface functionality and interfacial strength lost during thermal recycling. Interfacial strength will be characterized with IFSS tests and bulk properties with ILSS tests. The project is an industrial collaboration with Composite Recycling, which supplies the fibers and requires a non-disclosure agreement.

projects.title: Upcycling the recycled carbon fibers by tailoring the interface
projects.summary: Design and synthesis of a sizing coating for thermally recycled carbon fibers to restore interfacial strength with an Elium matrix, followed by IFSS, ILSS and flexural characterization of the resulting composites. The project is an industrial collaboration with Composite Recycling and requires signing a non-disclosure agreement.

projects.title: Vitrimer formulations for circular composite industry
projects.summary: Develop new vitrimer resin formulations for fiber reinforced polymer composites that can be recycled, repaired, or reprocessed at end-of-life while keeping thermoset-like performance. The work covers resin formulation and optimization, rheological and curing tests, thermo-mechanical characterization, and composite manufacturing and reprocessing, as part of an Innosuisse project with Huntsman.

projects.title: Wear Resistant Superhydrophobic Surfaces
projects.summary: Develop wear-resistant superhydrophobic coatings using a UV-curable silicone acrylate binder and surface-methacrylated fumed silica nanoparticles. The covalent bonds formed during UV photopolymerization between the nanoparticles and the binder are expected to improve abrasion resistance.

projects.title: Degradation investigation in photoelectrochemical devices for hydrogen production
projects.summary: Investigate degradation mechanisms in photoelectrochemical devices used for hydrogen production.

projects.title: Design and optimization of volume of fluid simulations in newly designed porous media for fuel cells
projects.summary: Design and optimize volume of fluid simulations in newly designed porous media for fuel cells.

projects.title: Design of optical flux homogenizer for a parabolic dish based concentrated PV system
projects.summary: Design an optical flux homogenizer for a concentrated photovoltaic system based on a parabolic dish.

projects.title: Design, simulation and experimental validation of a high solar flux calorimeter
projects.summary: Design and simulate a calorimeter for high solar flux, then validate it experimentally. Detailed project descriptions are available on request.

projects.title: Development of a catalytic hydrogen stove
projects.summary: Develop a catalytic stove that runs on hydrogen as a cooking fuel.

projects.title: Development of a quasi 2D multi-physical transport model of a PEC device made of a morphologically complex photoelectrode
projects.summary: Build a quasi-2D multi-physics transport model of a photoelectrochemical (PEC) device with a morphologically complex photoelectrode.

projects.title: Development of a setup for ethanol quantification under CO2 electrochemical reduction at electrode/solid electrolyte interface
projects.summary: Develop an experimental setup to quantify ethanol produced by CO2 electrochemical reduction at the electrode/solid electrolyte interface. Detailed project descriptions are available on request.

projects.title: Environmental, social and health impact of hydrogen as cooking fuel in the Global South
projects.summary: Assess the environmental, social and health impacts of using hydrogen as a cooking fuel in the Global South. Project carried out in collaboration with HOBEL.

projects.title: Fabrication of micro-patterned water-splitting photoelectrodes and their experimental characterization
projects.summary: Fabricate micro-patterned photoelectrodes for water splitting and characterize them experimentally.

projects.title: High-flux solar simulator: Testing of an experimental chamber for experiments under controlled conditions
projects.summary: Test an experimental chamber for experiments under controlled conditions in a high-flux solar simulator.

projects.title: Modeling and Characterization of the Natural-Convection Oil-Based Insulation for Medium Frequency Transformers
projects.summary: Model and experimentally characterize natural-convection oil-based insulation for medium frequency transformers. Detailed project descriptions are available on request.

projects.title: Modeling and optimizing of the air flow and the heat transfer in a robust and affordable infant incubator
projects.summary: Model and optimize the air flow and heat transfer in a robust and affordable infant incubator. Detailed project descriptions are available on request.

projects.title: Modeling, designing, and optimizing devices performing artificial photosynthesis
projects.summary: Model, design and optimize devices that perform artificial photosynthesis.

projects.title: Modeling light absorption, electron-transfer kinetics and species transport in particle based photocatalytic reactor for water splitting
projects.summary: Model light absorption, electron-transfer kinetics and species transport in a particle-based photocatalytic reactor for water splitting.

projects.title: Modeling of gas-fed test electrolyzers
projects.summary: Model gas-fed test electrolyzers. Project carried out in collaboration with LNCE.

projects.title: Numerical characterization of transport properties for artificially generated 3D macro-porous ceria in solar-assisted water splitting application
projects.summary: Numerically characterize the transport properties of artificially generated 3D macro-porous ceria for solar-assisted water splitting.

projects.title: Optimization of hydrophilic/phobic zones in fuel cell gas diffusion layers for enhanced evaporative cooling
projects.summary: Optimize the arrangement of hydrophilic and hydrophobic zones in fuel cell gas diffusion layers to enhance evaporative cooling.

projects.title: Process simulation of a concentrated solar hydrogen, heat and power production facility for optimal demand matching
projects.summary: Simulate the process of a concentrated solar facility producing hydrogen, heat and power, to optimize matching with demand.

projects.title: Radiative transfer in nano-structure media for solar energy conversion applications
projects.summary: Study radiative transfer in nano-structured media for solar energy conversion applications.

projects.title: Smart and scalable control scheme for hydrogen production site
projects.summary: Design a smart and scalable control scheme for a hydrogen production site. Project carried out in collaboration with DECODE.

projects.title: Thermal design and behavior of integrated photoelectrochemical devices in a parabolic dish concentrator
projects.summary: Study the thermal design and behavior of integrated photoelectrochemical devices placed in a parabolic dish concentrator.

projects.title: Uncoupling conduction and radiation heat transfer in high-temperature porous media
projects.summary: Separate conduction and radiation heat transfer in high-temperature porous media.

projects.title: 3D Bioprinting of Sacrificial Stiffening Layers for Self-Inserting Needles on Peripheral Nerve Interfaces
projects.summary: Develop an extrusion bioprinting process to deposit a water-soluble sacrificial stiffening layer that protects high-aspect-ratio microneedles on a peripheral nerve cuff during implantation and then dissolves to let the needles self-insert.

projects.title: Designing the Future of Wireless Neural Interfaces: Microfabrication of Coils and Antennas for Soft Bioelectronics
projects.summary: Microfabricate and characterize flexible polyimide thin-film coils for wireless power at about 13.56 MHz and antennas for the Bluetooth band, aiming at a fully implantable ECoG platform for small animals.

projects.title: Development of Flexible Field Effect Transistor (FET)-Based Sensors for Neural Biosensing Applications
projects.summary: Develop flexible FET-based biosensors to detect neurotransmitters such as dopamine and glutamate and other neural biomarkers, complementing neural signal recordings with biochemical information.

projects.title: Electrochemical Aging of PEDOT-Coated Neural Interfaces: Characterizing Long-Term Stimulation Stability
projects.summary: Evaluate the electrochemical stability of PEDOT coatings on active sites of a peripheral nerve interface under prolonged stimulation, chemical aging and mechanical stress, to identify safe stimulation currents and delamination failure modes.

projects.title: Optimizing Microperforated Polymer Membranes for 3D Brain Organoid Mechanobiology
projects.summary: Investigate how perforation size, geometry, thickness and material of polymer membranes (PI, PDMS) affect brain organoid integration and mechanobiological response under active strain. The student would fabricate membranes, seed organoids, apply mechanical stretching and perform fluorescence imaging.

projects.title: Thermal Modelling and Management in Soft Flexible microLED Arrays
projects.summary: Develop thermal and optical models of soft microLED arrays for optogenetic stimulation, and build an optimization pipeline that maps target irradiance to device and stimulation parameters while limiting tissue heating.

projects.title: Towards the Thinnest Fully Implantable, Wireless Bidirectional Neural Interface
projects.summary: Integrate ultra-thin polyimide neural electrodes, flip-chip silicon chips, wireless power coils and Bluetooth Low Energy antennas into a single fully implantable bidirectional neural interface, and validate it electrically and in small-animal experiments.

projects.title: 3D Sound Localization
projects.summary: Build a toolbox that simulates human auditory localization behaviour, including the effect of hearing loss, to objectively assess whether hearing aid algorithms preserve spatial hearing cues. The project also involves measuring the HRTF of a Kemar dummy head and validating the toolbox with listening tests on normal-hearing and hearing-impaired participants.

projects.title: Auditory distance perception
projects.summary: Evaluate how hearing aids affect the auditory distance perception of hearing-impaired individuals. The project involves building a listening test facility with a loudspeaker on a motorised rail, then running listening tests with normal-hearing and hearing-impaired participants.

projects.title: Controlling the timbre of wind instruments with active control
projects.summary: Develop a scaled prototype of an active wind instrument: a cylindrical hollow duct with a ring of active electroacoustic absorbers that alter its acoustic impedance and thus its timbre. The work combines COMSOL FEM simulations, prototype development and acoustic assessment.

projects.title: Design of unprecedented sound sources: a dream come true with plasma loudspeakers?
projects.summary: The project aims to identify and possibly implement a purely omnidirectional corona discharge (plasma) loudspeaker configuration approximating a pulsating sphere, and to extend the approach to other canonical electroacoustic sources. It involves COMSOL and/or analytical modelling for geometry optimisation, followed by prototype construction and anechoic testing.

projects.title: Development and characterization of an acoustic matched source
projects.summary: Develop a numerical scheme (FDTD / Simulink) and an experimental set-up for an acoustic matched source that uses active control of a closed-box electrodynamic loudspeaker to match its impedance, characterized at multiple harmonics and then extended to broadband matching with a corona discharge actuator.

projects.title: Development of a Graphical User Interface for Electroacoustic Absorbers
projects.summary: Develop an analytical model and Simulink control interface for an Electroacoustic Absorber, implement direct impedance control on a prototype with a Speedgoat real-time target, and deliver a stand-alone GUI for characterising the absorber in an impedance tube.

projects.title: Enhancing Protein Design Through Advanced Graph Neural Networks
projects.summary: The project focuses on protein sequence design, creating protein sequences that perform specific functions, with advanced Graph Neural Networks used to improve design methods. Applications include drug development and bioengineering.

projects.title: Exploration and improvement of a data-agnostic multimodal deep learning architecture relying on a novel fusion strategy
projects.summary: Explore, improve and propose alterations of a data-agnostic multimodal deep learning architecture based on the Perceiver model, which integrates modalities sequentially. The work includes adapting layers for efficiency or performance, researching pre-training approaches, and testing data encoding tactics and combinations with standard fusion methods.

projects.title: Modeling translation elongation dynamics through Variational AutoEncoders
projects.summary: Model ribosome density profiles from ribosome profiling data using Variational AutoEncoders, first reconstructing the profile in one condition and then extending the decoder to take nutrient availability into account.

projects.title: Optimization of corona discharge loudspeakers
projects.summary: Identify and implement corona discharge loudspeaker configurations with improved sound radiation efficiency, aiming for a band-pass response over a wide audible band. The work combines COMSOL/analytical modelling for geometry optimisation with prototype construction and anechoic testing.

projects.title: Plasmacoustic headphones
projects.summary: Design and simulate a fully open corona-discharge (plasma) headphone with no membrane, optimising the transducer geometry with COMSOL and/or analytical models, then build prototypes and test them on an artificial ear in anechoic conditions.

projects.title: VENOVA : an actively modified cylindrical cross-saxophone
projects.summary: Design an actuator and couplings, using CAD and 3D printing, to attach to the VENOVA instrument, then model the system and apply impedance control strategies to alter its sound in a playable way. The work includes objective measurements and playing tests.

projects.title: Concept-based representations in pretrained vision models: concept bottleneck models vs sparse autoencoders
projects.summary: Compares concept bottleneck models (CBMs), sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and hybrids of the two for learning concept-oriented representations in pretrained vision models. The goal is to assess interpretability, disentanglement, information leakage, and downstream usefulness.

projects.title: Graph diffusion with joint node-edge constraints
projects.summary: Aims to develop a graph diffusion method that natively enforces joint node-edge constraints during generation, such as valence consistency in molecular graphs. The goal is to improve state-of-the-art performance on real-world tasks such as molecular design.

projects.title: Graph Latent Diffusion Models
projects.summary: Aims to develop a graph-specific latent diffusion model that runs the diffusion process in a lower-dimensional latent space, to scale graph generation beyond small graphs.

projects.title: Learning from Art Brut: reading cognitive signatures in artworks
projects.summary: Applies deep learning and computer vision to digitised Art Brut collections from Lausanne, Bern and Heidelberg to extract and cluster recurrent visual patterns across diagnoses and artists. The aim is to find cognitive signatures of mental disorders, in collaboration with art-history and symbolism experts.

projects.title: Low-rank edge representations for scalable graph transformers
projects.summary: Investigates low-rank edge representations in graph transformers used for graph diffusion, to reduce the memory cost of the dense edge state. The project quantifies expressivity of low-rank edges and tests an implementation on benchmarks, including large graphs.

projects.title: Machine learning for molecular identification from tandem mass spectra
projects.summary: Aims to identify small molecules from tandem mass spectrometry data, which mostly remain unmatched to structures. Possible directions include conditional graph generative models, self-supervised foundation models for spectra, combinatorial optimization over molecular space, and uncertainty quantification. The project has a strong research focus and may lead to a publication.

projects.title: Mechanistic interpretability of looped diffusion language models
projects.summary: Studies and compares the internal dynamics of standard masked diffusion language models and looped/recursive variants using lens-based interpretability tools such as Logit Lens, Tuned Lens and Jacobian Lens. The goal is to understand how and when predictions form across layers, loops and denoising steps.

projects.title: Neural ODE graph networks for latent graph trajectories
projects.summary: Uses a Neural ODE formulation to learn latent graph trajectories with graph neural networks for temporal data, separating spatial and temporal updates. The goal is interpretability of the flow field and learning in scarce-data settings.

projects.title: Optimal-transport-based train/test splits for distribution shift
projects.summary: Develops optimization-based methods that build challenging train/test splits by maximizing the optimal transport discrepancy between training and test sets. The project has five difficulty levels, scaled to bachelor, master short-project, or master thesis scope, and requires efficient algorithms for large datasets.

projects.title: Physics-Informed Graph Neural Networks for High-Resolution Mesh-Based Simulations
projects.summary: Explores physics-informed graph neural networks to scale mesh-based simulations to high resolution, using coarser surrogate representations and hierarchical multi-scale modeling. The initial testbed is wind-tunnel dynamics.

projects.title: Robust Automatic Pathological Speech Detection
projects.summary: Develops robust deep learning approaches for automatic pathological speech detection that withstand recording artifacts and spurious correlations such as noise disparity between classes. The aim is to support clinical assessment of speech disorders.

projects.title: Scalable Graph Generation via Link Prediction
projects.summary: Aims to make graph generation scalable by replacing quadratic-cost sparse graph transformers with message-passing and link prediction modules that match transformer performance. Goals include reproducing SparseDiff and exploring other scalable methods such as latent diffusion.

projects.title: Topoformer: A Spatial-Informed Foundation Model for Spatial-Biology
projects.summary: Builds a foundation model for spatial biology by converting tissue images into compact spatial tokens using topological data analysis, then training transformers with self-supervised pretraining on large public cohorts. Target tasks include patient stratification, survival prediction and biomarker discovery.

projects.title: Data-driven wave propagation modeling for ultrasound imaging
projects.summary: Investigate data-driven modeling strategies that build a proxy for the wave propagation operator directly from recorded ultrasound signals, avoiding full-wave simulations. The goal is a low-dimensional, cheap model compared against model-based wavefields across media of varying complexity.

projects.title: Deep Neural Network uncertainty quantification: beyond Deep Ensemble
projects.summary: Survey whether the reconstruction quality and uncertainty estimates of a deep ensemble can be obtained at lower cost with a single network or modified architecture. Compare input perturbation, weight perturbation (e.g. Laplace-style approximation), and Bayesian neural network architectures.

projects.title: Development of a pre-processing pipeline for diffusion-weighted MRI data followed by the implementation of a deep-learning-based automatic lymph-node segmentation tool
projects.summary: Build a body DW-MRI pre-processing pipeline with quality control and non-rigid co-registration, then design and evaluate a deep-learning model that automatically segments lymph nodes from the co-registered volumes. The work also compares supervised, transfer-learning and self/unsupervised data strategies.

projects.title: Physics-Informed Learning for Sparse Measurement Selection in Diffusion MRI Protocol Design
projects.summary: Use machine learning to select a compact subset of diffusion MRI measurements that remains informative for estimating white matter model parameters, guided by physics-informed criteria such as Fisher information. The learned protocol is to be compared with baseline selection strategies using simulations and parameter estimation.

projects.title: Project at CHUV – Mapping functional connectivity in callosal dysgenesis
projects.summary: Analyse ADC-fMRI data from a cohort of children with callosal dysgenesis, from diffusion MRI timeseries preprocessing to group comparisons of brain activity and functional connectivity. The project is based at the CHUV Radiology Research Unit with a start date of Fall 2026.

projects.title: Synthetic Stroke Lesion Simulation and Deep Learning Segmentation Using HCP Data
projects.summary: Develop a simulation framework that generates synthetic acute stroke lesions on high-quality HCP diffusion and structural MRI, then train a deep segmentation network on this synthetic data. The trained model is to be evaluated on real stroke images from open clinical datasets such as ISLES and on CHUV network prototypes.

projects.title: Wavefield Extrapolation in Polar Coordinates for Ultrasound Imaging in Heterogeneous Media
projects.summary: Derive and implement a paraxial approximation of the 2D Helmholtz equation in polar coordinates to extrapolate acoustic wavefields over smoothly varying sound-speed media for curved ultrasound arrays. The solver is to be validated on simulated ultrasound data and benchmarked for accuracy, stability and efficiency, and released as open-source code.

projects.title: Acoustic levitation and micromanipulation
projects.summary: Explore acoustic levitation with a 20 kHz ultrasonic source by characterising the field, analysing radiation forces with nonlinear acoustics, adding side transducers to trap particles, and applying wavefront shaping in scattering environments.

projects.title: Active wind instrument with electroacoustic absorbers
projects.summary: Develop a scaled prototype of an active wind instrument: a cylindrical duct surrounded by a ring of active electroacoustic absorbers that alter its acoustic impedance and timbre. The work includes FEM simulations, prototype fabrication and acoustic assessment.

projects.title: Auditory distance perception with hearing aids
projects.summary: Evaluate how hearing-aid processing affects the ability of hearing-impaired listeners to perceive sound source distance. The project includes building a listening-test facility with a motorised rail-mounted loudspeaker, then running listening tests with normal-hearing and hearing-impaired participants.

projects.title: Band-pass corona discharge loudspeaker for sound radiation
projects.summary: Identify corona discharge loudspeaker configurations with a band-pass response over a wide audible band and improved radiated sound power, using COMSOL or analytical modelling followed by prototype measurements in anechoic conditions.

projects.title: Corona discharge based active acoustic metasurface in reflection
projects.summary: Develop a unit cell of a plasmacoustic metalayer in reflection and assess how sound reflection amplitude and phase can be controlled, with the aim of building an active metasurface that steers reflected wavefronts in anomalous directions.

projects.title: Dual corona discharge transducer for controllable directivity
projects.summary: Investigate achievable directivities of a dual corona discharge transducer made of two independently driven units, first by COMSOL simulation and then with an experimental prototype tested in anechoic conditions.

projects.title: Educational acoustic metacrystal interface
projects.summary: Replicate the existing acoustic metacrystal prototype and develop a user-friendly interface that changes its control parameters on the fly and performs acoustic measurements, as an educational tool to teach quantum physics concepts.

projects.title: Electrodynamic matched source with active control
projects.summary: Realise an acoustic matched source by active feedback control of a closed-box loudspeaker so that its impedance is matched to the incident field, then extend it to broadband matching with a corona discharge actuator. The work combines numerical simulation and impedance-tube measurements.

projects.title: Fully open corona discharge headphone
projects.summary: Simulate and implement a fully open, membrane-free corona discharge headphone to avoid the occlusion effect, then test it on an artificial ear facility while managing sound leakage.

projects.title: Micro-particle design for acoustically driven propulsion
projects.summary: Design and fabricate micro-particles of varying geometry by two-photon lithography, actuate them on a surface acoustic wave platform, and track their motion to understand how shape governs acoustically driven propulsion toward micro-robots.

projects.title: Omnidirectional corona discharge loudspeaker (pulsating sphere)
projects.summary: Identify and implement a purely omnidirectional corona discharge loudspeaker configuration approximating the ideal pulsating sphere. The project combines COMSOL or analytical modelling for geometry optimisation with prototype construction and anechoic tests.

projects.title: Plasmacoustic metalayer for subwoofer enclosures
projects.summary: Use a plasmacoustic metalayer, a thin ionised-air layer controlled by electric fields, to absorb low-frequency sound in loudspeaker cabinets, with COMSOL design, a small Speedgoat-controlled prototype, impedance-tube tests and subwoofer tests.

projects.title: Quantum gate implementation with classical waves
projects.summary: Implement basic quantum computing gates, such as CNOT and Hadamard, using classical acoustic or electronic signals on a prototype analog electronic platform.

projects.title: Self-adjustable electroacoustic absorber
projects.summary: Make a fixed electroacoustic absorber adaptive by developing signal-processing techniques that self-adjust its control parameters to unknown or time-varying environmental conditions, and validate it in an impedance tube.

projects.title: Silicon photonics and TFLN neural-network building blocks with ML-driven design
projects.summary: Design and simulate photonic neural-network building blocks in silicon photonics and thin-film lithium niobate using Flexcompute workflows, developing an ML-driven agent that optimises components such as waveguides, couplers, and Mach-Zehnder interferometers for a photonic AI accelerator.

projects.title: Stand-alone real-time controller for electroacoustic resonators
projects.summary: Develop a light, mobile, stand-alone real-time controller that replaces the laboratory-grade Speedgoat hardware for electroacoustic resonators, and apply it to damping ventilation noise in a cooktop hood.

projects.title: 8-blade EM-field sensor
projects.summary: Design of an eight-blade electromagnetic field sensor.

projects.title: Design of an implanted Huygens source antenna
projects.summary: Design an implanted Huygens source antenna combining the TE10 and TM10 spherical modes to maximise power radiated from a deep implant into free space. The work includes simulation, and fabrication and measurement if time permits.

projects.title: Electromagnetic evaluations
projects.summary: Visualise and evaluate electromagnetic quantities of electromagnetic sources using multipole field expansions, with a focus on sources below an electrical size of 0.3. The student implements the multipole expressions in MATLAB, studies power densities, loss mechanisms and stored energies, and compares the analytical results with HFSS and FEKO simulations of explicit antennas.

projects.title: Field-reconstruction Circuit (FRC)
projects.summary: Work on a field-reconstruction circuit (FRC) for microwave field measurements.

projects.title: Loss study of the directive implanted antenna
projects.summary: Study the losses of a practical directive implanted antenna (e.g. a patch embedded in biological tissue) by simulation and measurements, examining how encapsulation size, implant depth and frequency affect gain, and optimise the gain.

projects.title: Metasurface based biosensor
projects.summary: Design of a biosensor based on metasurfaces.

projects.title: Open stop band suppression technique benchmarking
projects.summary: Benchmark and categorize the available open stopband mitigation strategies for one-dimensional leaky-wave antennas, comparing their advantages and drawbacks through study, simulation, analytical modelling and, if time permits, fabrication and measurement.

projects.title: Patch Antennas for body-area Networks
projects.summary: Patch antenna design for wireless body-area networks.

projects.title: RFID tags for Living Cell Identification
projects.summary: RFID tags designed to identify living cells.

projects.title: Understanding When Radiation Occurs: The Role of Discontinuities
projects.summary: Study of how electromagnetic radiation arises from discontinuities in structures.

projects.title: USB 3.2 Push-Pull Connector
projects.summary: Design a new push-pull connector that can carry USB 3.2 signals, integrated in a 9 mm or 11 mm diameter push-pull system and withstanding 100 W. The student reviews the frequency limits of existing connectors, proposes a new design by numerical simulation, and may build and characterize prototypes at LEMO if time permits.

projects.title: Mechanics of Disordered Network Structures
