projects.summary: Investigate structure-property relationships in disordered two-dimensional networks by building a numerical simulation framework that analyses linear and non-linear responses across network topology, pre-stress levels and bond properties. The student contributes to in-house simulation code.

projects.title: Non-equilibrium Dynamics in Biological Tissues
projects.summary: Study the emergent non-equilibrium dynamics of biological tissues under different types and magnitudes of active fluctuations, such as junctional tension and cell crawling. The student implements active processes in the Active Foam Model and focuses on phenomena such as cell sorting, wound healing or collective cell dynamics.

projects.title: Searching for Ground States of Disordered Particle Packings
projects.summary: Develop annealing algorithms to find low-energy, ideally ground-state, configurations of disordered particle packings, combining a physics-based structure-energy approach with a machine-learning approach. The student runs particle packing simulations to build datasets and trains an in-house AI model to guide the search.

projects.title: Twitching Motility of Bacterial Locomotion
projects.summary: Understand how the dynamics of pili in a single bacterial cell (Pseudomonas aeruginosa) produce distinct locomotion patterns. The student develops a numerical framework covering pili extrusion rate, attachment rate and pulling force, which may be extended to pattern formation in bacterial aggregates.

projects.title: 3D Printing of Flexible Microstructures for Acoustic Microrobots
projects.summary: Cleanroom fabrication of acoustically responsive flexible microstructures, followed by testing them on the lab's acoustic actuation platform to study how fabrication parameters and geometry affect their dynamic response.

projects.title: Design and developpment of an in vitro phantom for local biomarker sampling
projects.summary: Design, build, and test a laboratory setup mimicking blood flow through a network of small branching veins, to study how flow, mixing, catheter position, and sampling speed affect locating a local source of hormone production (adrenal venous sampling).

projects.title: Design improvements and characterisation of an Omnidirectional Magnetic Actuation System
projects.summary: Improve the hardware design of the rotating permanent-magnet end effector of the OmniMag magnetic actuation system, then characterise the improved system in terms of magnetic field control, precision, and responsiveness.

projects.title: Design Optimization of Acoustic Actuators
projects.summary: Develop a design and manufacturing framework for acoustic actuators, combining theoretical analysis and computational simulations of coupled mechanical vibrations, fluid dynamics, solid mechanics, and acoustics.

projects.title: Development of a Fluid-jet-based Gripper
projects.summary: Design, manufacture, and experimental characterisation of a miniaturised fluid-jet gripper that uses high-speed airflow through a nozzle or funnel to generate controllable gripping forces for delicate objects. The project studies how nozzle geometry and operating conditions affect gripping performance.

projects.title: Development of an In-vitro Fluidic Test Platform for Endovascular Instruments
projects.summary: Hands-on assembly and calibration of an in-vitro fluidic test platform that simulates coronary artery conditions, including phantom fabrication, flow and pressure control systems, and sensor integration, for evaluating endovascular sensors.

projects.title: Endovascular neural probes for minimally invasive brain recording
projects.summary: Development and experimental validation of ultra-flexible endovascular neural probes that record neural signals from deep brain regions through blood vessels, mainly targeting epilepsy. Work can cover microfabrication, device assembly, phantom testing, computer vision tracking, and signal processing.

projects.title: Microfabrication of endovascular microcatheters
projects.summary: Design and fabricate ultra-miniaturised, highly flexible microcatheters able to navigate microscopic brain vessels, followed by mechanical and functional characterisation and in vitro testing.

projects.title: Optimization of MEMS Pressure Sensors for Endovascular Applications
projects.summary: Optimise the design of MEMS pressure sensors integrated in endovascular guidewires to improve sensitivity and reliability for coronary artery disease diagnosis, using cleanroom fabrication and rigorous characterisation.

projects.title: Alignment-based conformance checking
projects.summary: Build a neuro-symbolic conformance checking framework that translates natural language regulatory articles (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR) into linear temporal logic specifications and evaluates them on execution traces of multi-agent systems. The aim is a transparent mechanism that detects and explains compliance risks.

projects.title: Continuous latent flow matching for multimodal spatial reasoning
projects.summary: Develop a single-step continuous latent flow architecture that maps directly from multimodal inputs (video, audio, language instructions) to latent action-reasoning representations for Vision-Language-Action models. The aim is accurate spatial problem-solving in a single forward pass, replacing multi-step chain-of-thought generation.

projects.title: Contrastive latent alignment for multimodal reasoning
projects.summary: Explore a contrastive latent alignment process that enforces cross-modal and preference alignment within continuous latent reasoning paths, to handle conflicting sensory inputs that corrupt latent representations. Suggested methods include cross-modal contrastive trajectory optimization and direct preference alignment over continuous latent manifolds.

projects.title: Linguistic and stylometric style transfer for long-form speech anonymization
projects.summary: Use sequence-to-sequence style-transfer models to translate or obfuscate individual speaking styles, syntax and dialectal markers in long-form recordings, so speakers cannot be re-identified from linguistic cues. The focus is French/Italian or German, including Swiss German, with evaluation with human participants and real-world datasets in collaboration with RTS.

projects.title: Locating and ablating circuit-level private attribute sub-networks
projects.summary: Use activation-space dictionary learning to map the circuits that encode specific private attributes (PII) in AI models, then ablate or orthogonalize these latent directions. The goal is to remove PII while preserving zero-shot task performance, without retraining or fine-tuning the model.

projects.title: Privacy guarantees for speech anonymization
projects.summary: Build a framework that explicitly bounds and minimizes mutual information across speech modalities (acoustic, emotional prosody, linguistic stylometrics), providing information-theoretic privacy guarantees against adaptive adversaries. The work combines AI signal processing, deep generative modeling and privacy theory, with evaluation with human participants and RTS data.

projects.title: Visual stream parsing for compliance auditing
projects.summary: Design a dynamic legal-visual (or legal-audio-visual) concept engine that extends static concept probing to real-time video streams. It would fuse vision-language or audio-visual-language streaming backbones with ontology graph mapping to track entities, infer sensitive personal attributes and map scene semantics to legal frameworks.

projects.title: Voice anonymization with preservation of emotional prosody in multilingual settings
projects.summary: Design, implement and evaluate an AI-based acoustic transformation framework that masks speaker identity while preserving emotional prosody, semantic meaning and intelligibility. The focus is French/Italian or German, including Swiss German, with evaluation with human participants and real-world datasets in collaboration with RTS.

projects.title: Biophysical Modelling of Microstructural Diffusion MRI in the Rodent Brain
projects.summary: Use advanced biophysical models of diffusion MRI to extract quantitative maps of brain microstructure in animal models of disease compared with healthy controls. Possible applications include Parkinson's disease and creatine-related conditions.

projects.title: Community Detection in Directed (Brain) Networks
projects.summary: Aims to develop community detection for directed and asymmetric networks, such as brain networks, rather than the undirected graphs usually assumed.

projects.title: Developmental Trajectories of Perinatal Resting-State fMRI dynamics
projects.summary: Aims to investigate the maturation of brain functional dynamics during the perinatal period, for example by applying Co-Activation Pattern (CAP) analysis.

projects.title: Dynamic mode decomposition of fMRI during film watching
projects.summary: Applies dynamic mode decomposition (DMD), a latent space discovery method, to fMRI data acquired while participants watch films, to explore brain activity under naturalistic stimuli.

projects.title: Encoding and Decoding fMRI during film watching
projects.summary: Studies human brain encoding and decoding during naturalistic stimuli, namely film watching, extending earlier work on simple images.

projects.title: Graph signal processing to investigate structure-function coupling during sleep
projects.summary: Treats fMRI signals as defined on the structural brain graph to study how functional activity emerges from anatomical fiber bundles during sleep, using graph signal processing.

projects.title: Investigating memory consolidation during sleep with functional MRI
projects.summary: Uses a dataset of lucid dreamers scanned with fMRI while learning a hand motor sequence awake and during sleep, to investigate the brain mechanisms of memory consolidation.

projects.title: Longitudinal Brain Connectomics and Functional Fingerprinting in Chronic Tinnitus
projects.summary: Investigates how large-scale brain networks reorganize during neurofeedback treatment for chronic tinnitus. The project is offered as a semester or MSc thesis project.

projects.title: Structural connectivity of the human brain: what can we learn from intracerebral electrophysiological recordings in epileptic patients?
projects.summary: Study the structural connectivity of the human brain using intracerebral electrophysiological recordings from epileptic patients, within a connectomics framework that represents brain data in healthy and pathological conditions.

projects.title: The role of the hippocampus in tracking personal goals
projects.summary: Analyses fMRI scans of healthy subjects performing specific tasks to investigate the role of the hippocampus in distinguishing goals over time.

projects.title: Unraveling the contrast mechanism of neuromelanin-sensitive MRI
projects.summary: Investigate the contrast mechanism of neuromelanin-sensitive MRI, a technique that detects pathological alterations in diseases such as Parkinson's disease and schizophrenia, and that is thought to reflect catecholaminergic function rather than neuromelanin itself.

projects.title: Deep learning for deepfake detection
projects.summary: Train convolutional neural networks in a supervised way to detect deepfake images and videos, collecting existing deepfake datasets and studying ensembles of trained CNNs. The student assesses performance across several datasets.

projects.title: Image compression for DNA based storage
projects.summary: Study state-of-the-art approaches for storing information in DNA and build an end-to-end image compression simulator for DNA storage based on publicly available implementations. The student analyses the simulator's performance.

projects.title: Mobile App for Privacy Protection on iOS or Android Platform
projects.summary: Develop a smartphone app that obfuscates personal visual information in images in a secure and recoverable way, with multi-region selection by touch and a simple key management system. The app should also support sharing protected images on social networks.

projects.title: Representation and interpretation of a Factuality Trust Indicator in JPEG Trust
projects.summary: Define and implement a JPEG Trust compatible way to represent content-based factuality information in media assets, with tools to generate and read it. The student builds Trust Profile examples combining factuality with other trust information and evaluates how factuality affects the Trust Report.

projects.title: Reverse image search for media-context verification in multimodal fact-checking
projects.summary: Build a component that searches the Web for earlier appearances of a submitted image and recovers their date, location and event, to improve detection of out-of-context misinformation in a JPEG Trust fact-checking pipeline. The work includes comparing candidate tools and evaluating on multimodal misinformation datasets.

projects.title: 3D visualization of the boundaries of the dielectrophoretic trapping volume
projects.summary: The project aims to visualize in 3D (tomography-like image stacks along z) the boundary where dielectrophoretic force falls below thermal Brownian randomization, to quantitatively estimate DEP force and particle polarizability. It uses microelectrode arrays with functionalized surfaces and dielectric layers of varying thickness, and compares results with numerical simulations.

projects.title: Monocrystalline silver flakes for applications in plasmonics
projects.summary: The project aims to develop a chemical synthesis procedure for large-aspect-ratio monocrystalline silver flakes and their nanopatterning, to build a low-loss plasmonic material platform. The student would characterise the nanostructures and compare them with numerical electromagnetic simulations.

projects.title: Quantum Emitters Coupled to Subwavelength Hyperbolic Phonon Polaritons
projects.summary: Investigate how quantum emitters interact with hyperbolic phonon polaritons in anisotropic nanophotonic structures such as hBN, using COMSOL simulations of polariton confinement combined with quantum-optical modelling of Purcell enhancement and collective emitter dynamics.

projects.title: Self-Consistent Modeling of Coupled Maxwell-Bloch Equations with the Finite-Difference Time-Domain Method
projects.summary: Develop a self-consistent framework that extends the open-source MEEP FDTD software to integrate the Bloch equations with electromagnetic field evolution, enabling simulation of light-emitter interaction in nanophotonic environments. The work covers single and collective emitter dynamics, plasmonic resonances, and coherence phenomena.

projects.title: De Novo Computational Design of a Cardiac Troponin I–C Binder for Real-Time Label-Free Biosensing
projects.summary: Design de novo protein binders targeting the cardiac troponin I–C complex, then produce, validate (SPR) and immobilize them on electrodes for lock-in capacitive biosensing of this myocardial infarction biomarker.

projects.title: Development and Validation of an Optical Sensor for Non-Invasive In Vivo Biomarker Quantification
projects.summary: Develop and experimentally characterize an optical measurement system for non-invasive in vivo detection and quantification of a biomarker in biological tissues, in collaboration with Xsensio SA. The position is financially compensated.

projects.title: Electrically characterizing a 2D-based biosensor for health monitoring purposes
projects.summary: Electrically characterize a 2D-material-based biosensor for health monitoring, with a work split of about 10% theory, 20% fabrication and 70% characterization.

projects.title: Functionalized Graphene-Based Sensor Platform for Cortisol Detection
projects.summary: Develop an aptamer-functionalized graphene sensing platform for real-time cortisol detection, covering functionalization optimization, characterization (Raman, XPS, SPR, QCM, electrical measurements), and integration with hardware and software for monitoring.

projects.title: Microfabrication of VO2 Microcantilevers/clamped-clamped beams
projects.summary: Microfabricate vanadium dioxide (VO2) MEMS microcantilevers and clamped-clamped beams with piezoelectric actuation to dynamically control the metal-insulator transition through strain, for strain-engineered sensors and adaptive electronic devices.

projects.title: Unlocking next-generation wearable protein biosensors
projects.summary: Improve the understanding and detection mechanisms of non-faradaic electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) biosensors for wearable protein sensing, combining literature review, equivalent-circuit modelling, cleanroom electrode fabrication and measurements with proteins.

projects.title: Acoustic resonators for Intracellular tagging
projects.summary: Fabricate miniaturized LAMB wave resonators on thin-film lithium niobate to serve as wireless acoustic tags that can be internalized in cells to probe and track them in real time.

projects.title: Aluminum Scandium Nitride on Quartz piezoelectric resonators
projects.summary: Develop a reactive sputtering protocol to deposit high-quality aluminum nitride thin films on quartz, combining quartz's stability with the larger piezoelectric coefficient of the thin film. The project includes film characterization by SEM, XRD and stress measurements, in collaboration with Micro Crystal AG.

projects.title: Angular dependence of Ion Beam etching rates for acoustic resonator fabrication
projects.summary: Characterize the angular dependence of ion beam etching rates for AlScN, LiNbO3 and SiO2 and develop a numerical model of the evolution of the etched profile, to optimize fabrication of piezoelectric resonators.

projects.title: Design of photonic integrated circuits with phase change materials
projects.summary: Contribute to the design of a multi-layer DUV stepper reticle for prototype photonic integrated circuits with phase change materials, and model thermal and optical behaviour of the components with COMSOL.

projects.title: Development of a wafer-level packaging for vacuum encapsulation of microfluidic devices
projects.summary: Investigate and implement a wafer-level method to vacuum-encapsulate suspended microchannel resonators directly after fabrication, while still allowing fluidic delivery. The project includes a literature review, fabrication and characterization of a chosen packaging method, and experiments with packaged devices.

projects.title: Development of PZT Deposited by Pulsed Laser Deposition for NEMS
projects.summary: Study pulsed laser deposition of piezoelectric PZT thin films and contribute to their deposition and dry etching in the CMi cleanroom, to obtain high-quality layers for NEMS.

projects.title: Fabrication of glass suspended microchannel resonators
projects.summary: Fabricate suspended microchannel resonators (SMRs) in glass (SiO2) instead of silicon nitride, to improve calorimetry sensitivity thanks to glass's lower thermal conductivity. The work includes process adaptation in the cleanroom, electrode fabrication, and characterization.

projects.title: Fabrication of microchannels with a two-photon-absorption-based 3D nano-printer
projects.summary: Optimize the fabrication of thin-walled microchannels with the Nanoscribe two-photon 3D nano-printer at CMi, and develop a process flow that releases suspended structures with a fluidic network. The project includes CAD design, SEM inspection and packaging for fluidic operation.

projects.title: FEM modelling of energy dissipation in Suspended Microchannel Resonators
projects.summary: Use COMSOL finite element modelling and literature review to study the energy dissipation of suspended microchannel resonators, including the effect of fluid viscosity and channel position. The project extends an existing model to high-viscosity fluids.

projects.title: FEM simulations on resonator viscous damping in liquid environment
projects.summary: Use COMSOL simulations to study how viscous damping in liquids affects the quality factor of PAW resonators in biological media, and optimize the design to reduce fluid-induced losses.

projects.title: Ferroelectric properties of III-V semiconductors
projects.summary: Investigate the ferroelectric properties of high scandium-content AlScN thin films, including polarization and displacement curves, coercive field, and the effect of high-voltage poling on electrical and crystalline properties.

projects.title: Investigation of buried channels profile with respect to etching chemistries and silicon crystal orientation planes
projects.summary: Study the profile of microchannels etched directly into silicon as a function of etching chemistry and silicon crystal orientation. The project includes fabricating the channels and inspecting their cross-sections by SEM.

projects.title: Micro-optomechanical systems for harsh environments
projects.summary: Design and fabricate micro-optomechanical resonators to be integrated into optical fibers as sensors that operate in harsh industrial conditions, with optical readout. The project is carried out with the startup Miraex and the master project is sponsored.

projects.title: Novel AFM Cantilever Design for Cell Growth measurements
projects.summary: Design, simulate, fabricate and characterize a new AFM cantilever compatible with Nanosurf equipment, to provide more stable measurements of cell growth. The project is done in collaboration with Nanosurf.

projects.title: Optimisation of III/V semiconductors Reactive-Ion Etching
projects.summary: Investigate etch rate, selectivity and sidewall verticality of AlN and AlScN on a more aggressive inductively coupled plasma etcher, to enable etching of scandium-alloyed aluminum nitride for RF filters.

projects.title: PCB and circuit design for NEMS characterization
projects.summary: Design a circuit with background cancellation and/or impedance matching, and a PCB built with the Electronics Workshop, to measure NEMS devices. The project includes equivalent-circuit modelling of the matching and amplification stages.

projects.title: Piezoelectric materials on superconductors for quantum acoustics
projects.summary: Explore sputtering of superconducting electrodes and piezoelectric thin films adapted to cryogenic conditions, for acoustic resonators coupled to superconducting qubits in quantum acoustics.

projects.title: Piezoelectric MEMS for vibrations sensing
projects.summary: Develop a MEMS-based piezoelectric vibration sensor (vibrometer) as a miniaturized next-generation alternative to current aerospace sensors. The work covers analysis of transduction options, design, and fabrication in the EPFL CMi cleanroom.

projects.title: PMUTs for acoustic spectroscopy
projects.summary: Design and fabricate piezoelectric micromachined ultrasound transducers (PMUTs) with integrated microfluidic channels to perform acoustic spectroscopy of biological samples flowing through the channels.

projects.title: SAW-based acoustic spectrometer
projects.summary: Design, simulate and fabricate a miniaturized surface acoustic wave platform with a microchannel for trapping cells and characterizing their elasticity, aiming at detecting cancerous cells.

projects.title: Study of linear coupling in NEMS
projects.summary: Analyze how the strength of linear mechanical coupling between adjacent NEMS resonators depends on the physical constraints acting on them, using simulations, fabrication of a set of devices, and characterization of frequencies, quality factors and coupling rates.

projects.title: Linear and nonlinear characterization of gallium nitride optical devices
projects.summary: The semester project covers the characterization of gallium nitride (GaN) optical waveguides, ring resonators and modulators fabricated by Hexisense. The student would first verify linear behaviour through coupling and propagation loss tests, then explore nonlinear response under continuous and pulsed regimes and electro-optic modulation of the resonators.

projects.title: Optical Characterization of Periodically-Poled Thin-Film Lithium Niobate Waveguides
projects.summary: The project focuses on second-harmonic generation and difference-frequency generation in periodically-poled thin-film lithium niobate (PPLN) waveguides, aiming for broadband operation and/or high conversion efficiency. The student would perform optical measurements at different pump/signal wavelengths and temperatures, and post-process them to extract waveguide intrinsic properties.

projects.title: Accelerated Perovskite Solar Cell Development through Machine Learning
projects.summary: Use machine learning to accelerate the development of perovskite solar cells.

projects.title: Advancing Fully Inorganic Evaporated Perovskite Solar Cells through Interface Engineering
projects.summary: Improve fully inorganic evaporated perovskite solar cells through interface engineering.

projects.title: Atomic layer deposited thin-films towards stable perovskite-silicon tandems
projects.summary: Develop atomic layer deposited thin films to enable stable perovskite-silicon tandem solar cells.

projects.title: Building a colorimeter for accurate color-characterization of building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) applications
projects.summary: Build a colorimeter to accurately characterise the colour of building-integrated photovoltaic modules.

projects.title: Characterization of electrical and structural properties of innovative contact schemes for Si solar cells
projects.summary: Characterise the electrical and structural properties of innovative contact schemes for silicon solar cells.

projects.title: Characterization of silicon-based layer stacks for passivating contact solar cells
projects.summary: Characterise silicon-based layer stacks used in passivating contact solar cells.

projects.title: Colorimetry and reliability of colored PV modules
projects.summary: Study the colorimetry and reliability of coloured photovoltaic modules.

projects.title: Development and Optimization of Capping Layers for Temperature-Stable Passivating Contact Solar Cells
projects.summary: Develop and optimise capping layers for temperature-stable passivating contact silicon solar cells.

projects.title: Development of durable perovskite solar cells through encapsulation, stress-testing, and post-mortem analysis
projects.summary: Develop durable perovskite solar cells by working on encapsulation, stress testing and post-mortem analysis of degraded devices.

projects.title: Development of Intrinsically Stable Wide Bandgap Perovskite Compositions
projects.summary: Develop wide bandgap perovskite compositions that are intrinsically stable.

projects.title: Doped silicon layers as photocathodes for micro-channel plate detectors
projects.summary: Develop doped silicon layers to serve as photocathodes for micro-channel plate detectors.

projects.title: Electric vehicles as energy carriers for enhanced energy autonomy and universal energy access
projects.summary: Study electric vehicles as energy carriers to improve energy autonomy and universal energy access.

projects.title: Fabrication, measurement, and thermomechanical modelling of 3D-shaped PV module for electric-vehicle application
projects.summary: Fabricate and measure a 3D-shaped photovoltaic module for electric vehicles and model its thermomechanical behaviour.

projects.title: high-throughput stability measurements of perovskite semiconductors
projects.summary: Perform high-throughput stability measurements on perovskite semiconductors.

projects.title: Implementation of electronics and solar cells in Stöckli racing skis
projects.summary: Integrate electronics and solar cells into Stöckli racing skis.

projects.title: Metallization of Si solar cells with passivating contacts
projects.summary: Develop metallization for silicon solar cells with passivating contacts.

projects.title: Reliability modelling of composite structures backsheet for lightweight photovoltaic applications
projects.summary: Model the reliability of composite backsheet structures for lightweight photovoltaic applications.

projects.title: Solar Powered Freight Transport in Eastern Africa
projects.summary: Study solar-powered freight transport in Eastern Africa.

projects.title: Thermal and Airflow Simulation of an Elevated Bifacial Photovoltaic Module
projects.summary: Simulate the thermal behaviour and airflow around an elevated bifacial photovoltaic module.

projects.title: Understanding the degradation mechanism of the encapsulants in lightweight PV modules
projects.summary: Investigate how encapsulants degrade in lightweight photovoltaic modules.

projects.title: Understanding the degradation of coloured solutions for BIPV applications
projects.summary: Study the degradation of coloured solutions used in building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) applications.

projects.title: Unlocking the value of residential solar-powered EV charging in Europe
projects.summary: Assess the value of residential solar-powered electric vehicle charging in Europe.

projects.title: Terrain-Adaptive Robotic Foot Using Negative Stiffness Structure
projects.summary: Develop a legged-robot foot that uses curved-origami structures with programmable positive and negative stiffness to switch between a compact stiff configuration on rigid ground and an expanded, load-distributing configuration on sand. The student would model, fabricate and experimentally compare this adaptive foot with a conventional rigid foot.

projects.title: Adaptive optics controller synthesis for ground-based telescopes
projects.summary: Design and synthesise a robust, real-time controller for an adaptive optics system that corrects atmospheric wavefront distortions in ground-based telescopes. Validation is planned through simulation and hardware implementation on an AO testbed.

projects.title: Data-driven adaptive control of an active suspension test bench
projects.summary: Set up an active suspension system test bench and apply data-driven adaptive control techniques to it, with data acquisition and controller implementation in LabVIEW on NI DAQs. The controller should be robust to parametric uncertainties and is to be verified and validated on the test bench.

projects.title: Data-driven controller synthesis with Distributionally Robust Control
projects.summary: Investigate Distributionally Robust Control (DRO) as an alternative control objective and develop corresponding data-driven controller synthesis methods. The work includes implementation in the lab's datadriven library and experimental validation with a focus on saturation-related constraints.

projects.title: Expanding the data-driven controller synthesis framework to new performance objectives
projects.summary: Extend the lab's data-driven controller synthesis framework, which currently supports H2, H-infinity and IQC-based robustness specifications, to alternative objectives such as H1 performance and regret-based criteria. The work covers theory, implementation in the lab's datadriven library, and validation on experimental systems, with focus on actuator saturation constraints.

projects.title: Partial feedback linearization for inverted pendulum swing-up
projects.summary: Implement a partial feedback linearization algorithm for the swing-up control of an inverted pendulum, and extend the algorithm to the data-driven paradigm. The controller will be implemented on the hardware setup using LabVIEW.

projects.title: Accuracy Assessment of RGB-Based Shape Reconstruction
projects.summary: Evaluate how accurately shapes reconstructed from RGB images match their real counterparts in an experimental setup. The work involves designing reference shapes, reconstructing them, and measuring reconstruction error to find the algorithm's limitations.

projects.title: AI-Powered Knee Moment Estimation: Mobile-Based Biomechanical Analysis to Predict Knee Injury Risk in Sports
projects.summary: Develop a machine learning pipeline that estimates knee moments during change-of-direction tasks from 2D frontal-view video captured with a single mobile device. The model is trained against laboratory OpenSim ground truth from football players.

projects.title: Elite Performance Analytics: Large-Scale IMU-Based CMJ and DJ Assessment in Professional Football
projects.summary: Pre-process, analyse and statistically evaluate a large IMU dataset from countermovement jump and drop jump assessments of about 320 professional football players across 16 teams. The goal is to identify performance trends across player roles.

projects.title: Generalisation of Tool Segmentation in Medical Robotic Imaging
projects.summary: Extend an existing image segmentation pipeline that detects a medical tool in a robotic experimental setup so that it segments multiple relevant classes. The aim is more robust image understanding for medical robotics.

projects.title: Probabilistic Modelling of Arterial Geometries
projects.summary: Develop probabilistic and deep learning methods to model and generate realistic arterial geometries learned from vascular data. The model is intended to support simulation, analysis or data generation in medical robotics and biomedical applications.

projects.title: Real-Time Image-Based Colour Assessment and Camera Calibration for a Scientific Imaging Setup
projects.summary: Improve a prototype software module that detects poor illumination or colour conditions in a medical robotics imaging platform. The module flags, rejects or accepts images based on quality criteria.

projects.title: Validating Athletic Performance: A Reliability and Validity Study of IMU and Video-Based Jump Analysis
projects.summary: Evaluate the reliability and validity of existing algorithms for drop jump, squat jump and velocity-based training analysis using IMU and video data. The work includes laboratory data collection, processing with the existing algorithms, and writing a scientific paper.

projects.title: 3D microelectrode for ultra-miniaturized neural implant
projects.summary: Develop a 3D microelectrode integrated into an ultra-miniaturized neural implant. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Body Dust: CMOS Design for Remote Powering by Electromagn. Coupling
projects.summary: Design CMOS circuits for remote powering of miniature devices through electromagnetic coupling. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Challenges in sub-millimetric Neurostimulators Wirelessly Powered via highly efficient Inductive Links
projects.summary: Address design challenges of sub-millimetre neurostimulators powered wirelessly through efficient inductive links. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: CMOS design for vision restoring by cortex stimulation
projects.summary: Design CMOS circuits for a vision restoration system based on electrical stimulation of the visual cortex. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Electrochemical Aptamer Biosensors for Alzheimer's Biomarker Detection
projects.summary: Develop point-of-care electrochemical aptamer biosensors for Alzheimer's biomarkers. The 6-month project covers sensor functionalization and characterization, dose-response and calibration, and selectivity and specificity testing against interfering molecules.

projects.title: Energy-learning based on volatile memristor
projects.summary: Investigate energy-learning mechanisms based on volatile memristors. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Lab-on-chip (LOC) based on memristive biosensor for project "in-memory sensing"
projects.summary: Develop a lab-on-chip based on a memristive biosensor for in-memory sensing. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Microfluidic Tear Sampling for Alzheimer's Biomarker Detection
projects.summary: Design and build a passive microfluidic chip that collects tear samples for Alzheimer's diagnostics. The work covers capillary-driven flow simulation, low-cost scalable material selection and prototype fabrication, and testing of tear collection against simulation predictions.

projects.title: Next-Generation Silicon Nanowire Biosensor for Cancer Marker Detection
projects.summary: Develop a silicon nanowire biosensor for detecting cancer markers. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: NPK Sensor: How to Detect NPK in the Soil
projects.summary: Develop a sensor to detect nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium (NPK) content in soil. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Optimization of Schottky Barrier Formation for Reconfigurable Field Effect Transistors (RFETs)
projects.summary: The project aims to optimize annealing conditions (temperature profile, ramp rate, duration, atmosphere) for forming Schottky barriers between metals such as Ni or Al and silicon nanowires in reconfigurable FETs. The student would fabricate and characterize structural and electrical properties of the devices to derive guidelines for robust contacts.

projects.title: Oscillatory Neuristor Based on SiNW Unipolar Memristor: Circuit Design & ODE Modeling
projects.summary: Design an oscillatory neuristor circuit based on a silicon nanowire unipolar memristor and model it with ordinary differential equations. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Printed Electrodes Fabrication for Alzheimer's Biomarker Detection
projects.summary: Develop scalable fabrication of biosensor electrodes using printing techniques such as screen-printing and inkjet printing. The work covers electrode design and material selection, a comparison of printing processes, and optimization of the best process for reproducible, medium-scale electrode fabrication.

projects.title: Soft Multi-Modal Biosensing Patch for Continuous Physiological Vitals Monitoring
projects.summary: Design a soft, multi-modal biosensing patch for continuous monitoring of physiological vital signs. Details are in a downloadable project description.

projects.title: Air Moisture Curable, 3D Printable Double Network Granular Elastomers
projects.summary: The project develops moisture-curable prepolymers as an alternative to UV or thermal initiation for the second network in 3D-printable double network granular elastomers. The student will synthesize and characterize prepolymers, prepare swollen microparticles, and study the rheology, printability and mechanical properties after curing.

projects.title: Dynamic and Reprocessable Elastomers
projects.summary: The project develops dynamic elastomeric materials that keep their mechanical integrity while gaining self-healing, reshaping and reprocessing abilities. The student will design, prepare and characterize polymer networks to see how network design controls mechanical performance, damage recovery and recyclability.

projects.title: Formulation of 3D printable double network granular elastomers
projects.summary: The project aims to understand how particle size, size distribution and shape affect the mechanical properties, microstructure and ink rheology of 3D-printable double network granular elastomers. The student will make elastomer microparticles, formulate direct ink writing inks, print and convert structures, and characterize them.

projects.title: Investigation of chemical devulcanization for improved tire recycling
projects.summary: The project investigates chemical devulcanization of end-of-life tire rubber to controllably break down its network. The student will study how the agent, its concentration and rubber formulation affect the process, characterize the changes, and reprocess the modified rubber into recycled elastomers.

projects.title: Meta-Stable Particle Synthesis for Low Energy Sintering
projects.summary: The project studies how crystallinity, chemistry, additives and size of synthesized meta-stable calcium carbonate particles affect their consolidation and sintering behavior, as a model for ceramics. The student will synthesize and characterize powders, then perform conventional and flash sintering, starting at EPFL and continuing at Empa.

projects.title: From Acid Amyloids to Functional Films: Role of Neutralization in Whey and Soy Systems
projects.summary: The project studies how pH-shift neutralization of protein amyloid fibrils modifies their morphology and dispersion in whey protein isolate and soy protein isolate matrices. The student will then cast bio-based films and evaluate their mechanical, wetting, moisture and water vapor barrier properties for sustainable packaging.

projects.title: Glycan-mimicking virucidal antivirals
projects.summary: This master project aims to design glycan-mimicking molecules that block viral attachment and irreversibly disrupt viruses, covering organic synthesis, characterization, and biological evaluation against viruses toward an orally available broad-spectrum antiviral lead.

projects.title: Nonspecific adsorption of proteins to surfaces (small molecule modulation)
projects.summary: This master project investigates how small molecules modulate nonspecific protein adsorption to model surfaces, examining whether they change protein-surface encounter kinetics, interfacial residence times, or surface-induced conformational transitions.

projects.title: Algorithmic collusion in electricity markets
projects.summary: Semester project investigating collusive outcomes when autonomous agents learn to bid in electricity markets, mainly through numerical simulations combined with theory.

projects.title: Controlling a Multi-drone Fleet for Traffic Monitoring
projects.summary: Coordinate a fleet of UAVs that collect traffic data at multiple locations, deciding where and when each drone collects data based on road importance and previous visits.

projects.title: Hybrid soft-actor critic benchmark
projects.summary: Benchmark a hybrid variant of soft actor-critic (SAC) that learns to autonomously build an arch, a task with a mix of continuous and discrete actions, against existing methods such as hybrid PPO.

projects.title: Multi-Agent Traffic Monitoring with Limited Information Sharing
projects.summary: Coordinate a UAV fleet that collects traffic data where fixed sensors are absent, prioritising important roads under limited information sharing between drones.

projects.title: Multi-Objective Optimization for Automated Theorem Proving
projects.summary: Work on automated theorem proving, where large language models trained with reinforcement learning generate formal proofs checked by proof assistants such as Lean or Isabelle.

projects.title: Reinforcement learning to achieve efficient equilibria in repeated games with partial observability
projects.summary: Design online learning algorithms that learn efficient equilibria of a long-horizon repeated game, focusing on leader-follower games where the follower's actions are partially observable. Master's thesis project at the intersection of reinforcement learning and game theory.

projects.title: Algorithms robust to errors in 3T-1C GC-eDRAM
projects.summary: Explore algorithms that can tolerate the random data losses of gain-cell eDRAM (GC-eDRAM) caused by limited retention time, such as neural networks and error-correction codes. The goal is to build a model relating algorithm accuracy to system power.

projects.title: Analog High-Performance Sorters for Telecommunications
projects.summary: Evaluate mixed-signal architectures for sorters that find the U smallest elements in large sets, as needed in 5G/6G and high-speed fiber systems. Optimize area, power and speed and compare against purely digital implementations in 16nm FinFET.

projects.title: Cellular Sensing: Traffic Safety Alert
projects.summary: Use real-time channel state information from cellular signals to detect the speed of approaching vehicles and classify traffic as safe or dangerous, to alert distracted pedestrians.

projects.title: Characterization of an in-memory computing on Silicon
projects.summary: Characterize two fabricated 65nm BLADE in-memory computing configurations across voltage and temperature conditions, using on-board test programs to extract memory metrics and verify functionality.

projects.title: Chip for Wi-Fi sensing
projects.summary: Move the lab's current FPGA-based Wi-Fi sensing system (activity detection, localization, vital-sign estimation) to a semi-custom ASIC, optimizing for area, power and speed. Work involves circuit design in Cadence with a standard-cell flow, plus exploration with VHDL/Verilog.

projects.title: chip2chip serial-link for RISC-V Microcontrollers
projects.summary: Integrate a chip-to-chip serial-link IP into X-HEEP so two microcontrollers can exchange memory-mapped read/write data, extending the Pynq-Z2 FPGA support and testing on two FPGAs.

projects.title: Compact low-static-power CAM bitcell
projects.summary: Design and simulate a novel compact CAM (content-addressable memory) bitcell with lower static leakage than conventional compact (<6T) cells, while keeping fast match-line evaluation. The design is to be validated under PVT variations and mismatch. Suited to 1-2 students.

projects.title: Configurable NM-Caesar near-memory computing RTL
projects.summary: Improve the NM-Caesar near-memory computing RTL so that memory size and number of banks are configurable. The work also aims to optimize the design and highlight energy, area and performance trade-offs.

projects.title: Decoder with Bit-Flipping Post-Processing for 6G wireless
projects.summary: Develop a low-complexity bit-flipping post-processing decoder for 6G wireless, design its hardware architecture, implement it in VHDL, and benchmark and optimize it.

projects.title: Design automation of in-memory computing
projects.summary: Automate the physical design of the BLADE in-memory computing architecture for arbitrary configurations in 65nm, starting with the memory decoder and local memory controller, and later explore open-source PnR tools.

projects.title: Design of A Matrix with Multiple Sizes and Its Decoder Implementation
projects.summary: Given a base matrix, design LDPC matrices with several lifting sizes (smaller ones nested in larger ones), analyze them in Matlab or C++, and verify them in a configurable LDPC ASIC decoder.

projects.title: Design of a Wireless Modem for IoT
projects.summary: Implement a LoRa transmitter: build a golden model including fixed-point arithmetic, design and implement its architecture in VHDL with a bus interface, and test it on an FPGA.

projects.title: Designing a decoder in 16nm FinFet
projects.summary: Implement a full-custom GRAND-based error-correction decoder in 16nm FinFET using dynamic logic and an in-memory computation style, and automate layout generation with Python scripts.

projects.title: Designing a Leakage Suppression SRAM / ROM in 16nm FinFET
projects.summary: Evaluate leakage suppression techniques on a memory macro for an always-on low-power circuit, characterize speed and leakage, and design a bitcell array with leakage suppression.

projects.title: Designing Analog Blocks for the GC-eDRAM at 16nm FINFET
projects.summary: Design well-known analog blocks (ADC and voltage buffers) for characterizing the new GC-eDRAM macro in 16nm FinFET technology, including literature research, layout and post-layout optimization.

projects.title: DPTLSL leakage-suppression logic characterization
projects.summary: Characterize and optimize cells and circuit architecture for the DPTLSL leakage-suppression logic family developed at TCL, targeting low-leakage, reliable operation for a FIR filter circuit. The work includes comparison with a standard CMOS library.

projects.title: DPTLSL RISC-V System-On-Chip
projects.summary: Build a very small version of the X-HEEP RISC-V microcontroller (CPU, one memory bank, GPIOs) and synthesize it with a custom differential-logic standard-cell library, producing a verified post-synthesis netlist.

projects.title: Drone Detection Radar Design
projects.summary: Design an RF circuit on PCB to detect the speed and position of drones, model the RF system for simulation, and process the data on a software-defined radio for real-time signal processing.

projects.title: Efficient MVM for Syndrome Computation in Decoders
projects.summary: Design a full-custom GF(2) matrix-vector multiplication accelerator in 16nm FinFET for syndrome computation in channel decoders, and compare it with standard-cell implementations in efficiency and performance.

projects.title: Elaboration of an In-Memory Computing Memory Compiler (Master Thesis)
projects.summary: Design an in-memory computing memory compiler in 65nm using open-source tools that generates GDS, LEF, LIB and SPICE files from memory size and configuration. Work covers physical design, simulation, characterization and scripting automation.

projects.title: Experimental evaluation of an SDR LoRa implementation
projects.summary: Evaluate the error-rate performance of the group's open-source software-defined radio (SDR) implementation of LoRa and compare it with commercial LoRa hardware implementations, using experimental evaluation with SDRs.

projects.title: GC-RAM Controller for X-HEEP
projects.summary: Design and implement a smart memory controller for dynamic GC-RAM integrated into the X-HEEP platform, handling refresh, access multiplexing, error detection and correction, and interfacing to a system bus.

projects.title: High-Throughput Hard-Decision Decoder for Optical Communications
projects.summary: Develop a low-complexity iterative bounded-distance hard-decision decoder for two-dimensional parity codes targeting 400G-800G optical fiber standards, implement it in VHDL, and benchmark it.

projects.title: Improved Belief Propagation Decoding for Short Codes
projects.summary: Improve sparse parity-check matrix transformations for belief propagation decoding of short codes, using machine learning, and construct short linear codes suited to sparse BP decoding for 6G uRLLC. Recommended for groups of at least two students.

projects.title: Improving blocks of the GC-eDRAM in 28nm FDSOI Process
projects.summary: Design new full-custom analog blocks (charge pump, sense amplifier) for the GC-eDRAM macro in 28nm FDSOI to extend data retention time, including simulation, layout and post-layout optimization.

projects.title: Integrating High-Speed Test Infrastructure into XHeep (Semester Project)
projects.summary: Integrate the IPbus-based high-speed Ethernet test infrastructure, already used at TCL for testing custom ASICs, into the XHeep project to replace slow legacy test interfaces.

projects.title: Interconnect-aware BP decoder architecture study (routing congestion)
projects.summary: Compare routing behavior of different belief-propagation (BP) decoder architectures to identify interconnect bottlenecks and scaling limits. The goal is to derive guidelines for a scalable, interconnect-aware BP decoder, evaluating how wire congestion affects area, power and delay.

projects.title: Low-complexity FEC decoding for optical communication
projects.summary: Explore forward error correction (FEC) decoding algorithms that meet optical communication standards for AI data center networks, and reduce their decoding complexity. Hardware decoder implementation is optional.

projects.title: Machine-learning-based drone localization with LoRa
projects.summary: Implement machine learning models that estimate drone location from noisy LoRa RSSI/SNR signals, using about 75k drone measurements taken around EPFL with four campus gateways. The goal is to evaluate their performance and robustness in LoRa-based IoT systems.

projects.title: Mioty Implementation
projects.summary: Improve the synchronization of an existing open-source software-defined radio implementation of the Mioty LPWAN standard so it works in real-world communications, and build a transceiver compatible with commercial devices.

projects.title: Mixed signal compute block
projects.summary: Design analog sorter blocks, including DACs and comparators, compatible with standard-cell dimensions, as a mixed-signal approach to accelerate digital bottlenecks in 5G/6G algorithms.

projects.title: Morphological filter circuit architectures (iterative, pipelined, unrolled)
projects.summary: Starting from a Python description of morphological filters (erosion, dilation, opening, closing), design three hardware circuit architectures (iterative, pipelined, unrolled). Compare them through post-synthesis power, performance and area (PPA) extraction.

projects.title: Multi-Bit Error Correction Code (ECC) for Gain-Cell eDRAM
projects.summary: Explore a better trade-off between parity storage overhead, latency and system power for multi-bit error correction in gain-cell eDRAM, then design, verify and implement the chosen ECC in ASIC.

projects.title: Open Reimplementation of the RP2040 PIO (Master Thesis)
projects.summary: Read the specifications of the Raspberry Pi RP2040 programmable I/O (PIO) block, implement its state machines in RTL, and integrate the result into the HEEP system with FPGA prototyping.

projects.title: Optimize Gain-Cell eDRAM Performance on X-Heep Platform
projects.summary: Optimize the cache line structure of gain-cell eDRAM on the X-Heep SoC platform by adding one or more buffer cache lines, to reduce read-modify-write and refresh overhead. Requires running benchmarks and hardware/software co-optimization.

projects.title: Project 1: Localization and User Activity Detection
projects.summary: Collect and label Wi-Fi signal data for different activities and locations, develop preprocessing and classification or localization models, and present a system detecting user activity, room state and location.

projects.title: Project 1: LoRa Transceiver Optimization and Evaluation
projects.summary: Characterize the open-source LoRa transceiver in terms of memory footprint, computational load and performance, then add features to the public repository.

projects.title: Project 2: LoRaWAN for SDR
projects.summary: Add LoRaWAN support to the open-source LoRa transceiver by creating an interface between an existing MAC-layer library and the SDR implementation in GNU Radio.

projects.title: Project 2: Vital-Signs Estimation
projects.summary: Use reflected wireless signals to estimate breathing rates of one or several people in different scenarios, collecting data and developing preprocessing and estimation models.

projects.title: Project 3: Hardware and Machine Learning for Enhancing Wi-Fi Radar
projects.summary: Design, implement and test a quantized neural-network canceller that removes the router's own transmit signal from received Wi-Fi signals, so that environmental reflections can be sensed.

projects.title: Project 3: Implementing a Mioty Transceiver
projects.summary: Build the first open-source software-defined radio implementation of a simple Mioty LPWAN transceiver and verify its compatibility with commercial radio chips.

projects.title: Project 4: 4G LTE Localization
projects.summary: Adapt an open-source 4G software radio suite to collect channel state information from LTE signals and use it to localize devices or device-free targets.

projects.title: Project 4: Characterizing the New WiFi HaLow
projects.summary: Set up a WiFi HaLow test environment at EPFL, define a test plan, and measure the performance and power of the first WiFi HaLow network in Switzerland, then write a report.

projects.title: Project 5: UWB Environment and Human Activity Sensing
projects.summary: Sense environments, vital signs and human activities from UWB/Wi-Fi channel estimates by synchronizing and preprocessing channel impulse responses and extracting activity information.

projects.title: Routing Design for Data Coupling in Decoders
projects.summary: Simplify the design of a flexible routing network that supports global coupling between cores in a multi-core LDPC decoder, analyze its performance in Matlab or C++, and implement it in ASIC.

projects.title: Test of the fabricated GC-eDRAM chip
projects.summary: Characterize fabricated GC-eDRAM chips in the lab by establishing communication with the chip, measuring temperature, voltage and frequency behavior, and comparing results with CAD simulations.

projects.title: Test Platform of Error-Correction Decoders on FPGA SoC
projects.summary: Build a reconfigurable FPGA SoC test platform for error-correction decoders (5G, 6G, optical), configuring I/O and CPU-FPGA communication, implementing and benchmarking the platform.

projects.title: Ultra-low power standard-cells library optimization for AO systems
projects.summary: Optimize, design and characterize a full-custom differential standard-cell library (DPTLSL) for always-on, leakage-dominated systems, and compare it with a standard CMOS library.

projects.title: 3D density map embedding for cryoEM
projects.summary: Build density map embeddings that capture the information in the cryoEM voxel grid using an autoencoder, and evaluate their biological meaningfulness. The project is a collaboration between the Laboratory for Biomolecular Modeling and the Computer Vision Laboratory.

projects.title: Behavioral studies in the laboratory
projects.summary: Hands-on experimental work with flies to examine how neural activation or other perturbations modulate animal behavior. The student designs experiments and analyzes their own data.

projects.title: Build a robotic fly
projects.summary: Construct an insect-inspired robot and test bioinspired algorithms of limb control, in collaboration with EPFL robotics groups. Nature's solutions to autonomous behavioral control are to be leveraged in robotics.

projects.title: Build artificial neural networks to control a simulated fly.
projects.summary: Develop biorealistic controllers for a physics-based neuromechanical simulation of the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster. The project lies at the interface of robotics, computer science and neuroscience, possibly in collaboration with the BioRobotics Laboratory.

projects.title: Study the full graph (connectome) of the fly nervous system
projects.summary: Improve and explore the fly connectome graph to answer specific questions about neural circuit motifs underlying complex motor behaviors. The project sits at the interface of computer science, mathematics and biology.

projects.title: Use computational tools to study animal behavior
projects.summary: Use computational and machine learning approaches to quantify and segment fly behaviors into individual actions, and link these behavioral sequences to simultaneously acquired neuroimaging data.

projects.title: Use computational tools to study neural circuit activity
projects.summary: Use computer vision and machine learning to extract neural activity patterns during behavior and make predictions linking behavioral and internal states. The project sits at the interface of computer science and neurobiology.

projects.title: Use robotic systems to automate biological experimentation
projects.summary: Develop automated vision-guided robotic systems that perform behavioral and/or neural experiments, to automate and democratize biological experimentation. The project sits at the interface of robotics and neurobiology, possibly in collaboration with the Microrobotics Laboratory.

projects.title: Masters project: AI-based generative approaches for de novo protein design
projects.summary: Develop diffusion generative models to design de novo proteins with specific biomedical applications. The student would help integrate physics-based loss functions into an existing deep learning framework for protein design.

projects.title: A Cross-Species Meta-Analysis of Astrocyte Transcriptional Diversity in Development and Disease (Dry)
projects.summary: Computational meta-analysis integrating public mouse and human single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq and multiomics datasets to build a cross-species astrocyte transcriptomic atlas. The project maps developmental and disease-associated astrocyte states and links them to GWAS risk loci for neurological and psychiatric disorders.

projects.title: Ex utero metabolic perturbation of the developing mouse brain
projects.summary: Wet and dry lab project in which the student acutely perturbs lipid metabolism in ex utero cultured mouse embryos during early brain formation. Effects are assessed with MALDI imaging mass spectrometry, spatial transcriptomics and confocal microscopy, followed by computational integration of spatial datasets.

projects.title: Linking Neuronal Function to Molecular Identity in Mouse Barrel Cortex (Dry and Wet)
projects.summary: Interdisciplinary project combining in vivo two-photon calcium imaging with spatial transcriptomics (Direct HybISS) to relate the activity of neurons to their molecular identity in adult mouse barrel cortex. The student contributes to an experimental pipeline that registers the same neurons across functional imaging and post-mortem transcriptomics.

projects.title: Circadian clocks in disease states and cancer
projects.summary: A semester project studying circadian clocks in disease states and cancer.

projects.title: Deep Learning Analysis of Human Histology Images
projects.summary: A semester project applying deep learning to analyse human histology images, as listed under the available semester projects.

projects.title: Latent space models for cyclic biomolecular processes and application to live microscopy imaging
projects.summary: A semester project developing latent space models for cyclic biomolecular processes, with application to live microscopy imaging.

projects.title: Machine learning multiomics data to identify gene regulatory networks across time, sex and tissues
projects.summary: A semester project using machine learning on multiomics data to identify gene regulatory networks across time, sex and tissues.
